syllogism: అన్ని కార్లు ఒక రకమైన వాహనాలు. ఏ జంతువు కారు కాదు. కాబట్టి, ఏ జంతువు వాహనం కాలేదు.
syllogism_orig: All cars are a type of vehicle. No animal is a car. Therefore, no animal can be a vehicle.

syllogism: Nada que sea un refresco es un jugo. Una parte de las cosas que son bebidas son jugos. La única conclusión lógica es que algunas bebidas no son refrescos.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a soda is a juice. A portion of the things that are beverages are juices. The only logical conclusion is that some beverages are not sodas.

syllogism: Alles, was ein Planet ist, ist ein Himmelskörper. Alles, was eine Sonne ist, ist ein Himmelskörper. Es gibt mindestens eine Sonne, die ein Planet ist.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a planet is a celestial body. Anything that is a sun is a celestial body. There exists at least one sun that is a planet.

syllogism: Elke kat is een onzichtbaar wezen. Een aantal katten zijn dieren. Bijgevolg is een deel van de dieren onzichtbaar.
syllogism_orig: Every cat is an invisible creature. A number of cats are animals. Consequently, a portion of animals are invisible.

syllogism: Nessuna capitale è un oceano. Alcune grandi città sono classificate come capitali. Pertanto, è chiaro che alcune grandi città non sono oceani.
syllogism_orig: There are no capital cities which are oceans. A select few large cities are classified as capital cities. Therefore, it is clear that some large cities are not oceans.

syllogism: Ogni città è un luogo. Qualsiasi cosa che è un luogo è una capitale. Quindi, ogni capitale è una città.
syllogism_orig: Every city is a location. Anything that is a location is a capital city. Therefore, every capital city is a city.

syllogism: Aucune étoile n'est un météore. Les météores sont, sans exception, des planètes. Un certain nombre de planètes sont des étoiles.
syllogism_orig: No star is a meteor. Meteors are, without exception, planets. A number of planets are stars.

syllogism: Cada gato es un animal. Todo lo que pueda llamarse perro es, sin excepción, un animal. Todo perro es un gato.
syllogism_orig: Every single cat is an animal. Anything that can be called a dog is, without exception, an animal. Every dog is a cat.

syllogism: జంతువులైన క్షీరదాలు ఏవీ లేవు. ఏనుగు అయినది ప్రతిదీ క్షీరదము. కాబట్టి, ప్రతి ఏనుగు జంతువు.
syllogism_orig: There are no mammals that are animals. Everything that is an elephant is a mammal. Thus, every elephant is an animal.

syllogism: Kila kitu ambacho ni ndege ni mnyama. Kila kiumbe ambacho ni shomoro ni mnyama. Kwa hivyo, shomoro wote ni ndege.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a bird is an animal. Every single creature that is a sparrow is an animal. Consequently, all sparrows are birds.

syllogism: Existen estudiantes que son adultos. Toda persona que es estudiante es una persona. Se sigue que ninguna persona es un adulto.
syllogism_orig: There exist students that are adults. Every single person who is a student is a person. It follows that not a single person is an adult.

syllogism: উদ্ভিদ কোনোভাবেই জীব নয়। যা কিছু গাছ তা সবই জীব। গাছকে উদ্ভিদ হিসেবে শ্রেণিবদ্ধ করা যায় না।
syllogism_orig: Plants are in no way living organisms. All things that are trees are living organisms. Trees cannot be classified as plants.

syllogism: Каждый автомобиль является транспортным средством. Всё, что является велосипедом, является транспортным средством. Некоторые велосипеды не являются автомобилями.
syllogism_orig: Every single car is a vehicle. Everything that is a bicycle is a vehicle. It is the case that some bicycles are not cars.

syllogism: Jedes einzelne Tier, das eine Spinne ist, ist ein Geschöpf mit acht Beinen. Einige der Dinge, die als Weberknechte bekannt sind, sind Geschöpfe mit acht Beinen. Folglich sind nicht alle Weberknechte Spinnen.
syllogism_orig: Every single animal that is a spider is a creature with eight legs. A few of the things known as daddy longlegs are creatures with eight legs. As a result, not all daddy longlegs are spiders.

syllogism: Einige Säugetiere sind Hunde. Es gibt einige Katzen, die Säugetiere sind. Katzen sind in keiner Weise Hunde.
syllogism_orig: Some mammals are dogs. There are some cats who are mammals. Cats are in no way dogs.

syllogism: Todo insecto es un animal. Todos los mamíferos son animales. En consecuencia, todo mamífero es un insecto.
syllogism_orig: Every insect is an animal. All mammals are animals. Consequently, every single mammal is an insect.

syllogism: Ogni singolo geco è un tipo di lucertola. Un certo numero di gechi sono anche rettili. Pertanto, alcuni rettili sono lucertole.
syllogism_orig: Every single gecko is a type of lizard. A number of geckos are also reptiles. Therefore, some reptiles are lizards.

syllogism: Non è il caso che ogni umano sia un maschio. Ogni singolo umano è una creatura con dieci zampe. Da ciò segue che alcune creature con dieci zampe sono maschi.
syllogism_orig: It is not the case that every human is a male. Every single human is a creature with ten legs. From this, it follows that some creatures with ten legs are males.

syllogism: Ni kweli kwamba hakuna jengo lolote ambalo ni chombo cha usafiri. Kila nyumba, bila ubaguzi, ni jengo. Kwa hivyo, hakuna nyumba yoyote inayoweza kuwa chombo cha usafiri.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no building is a vehicle. Each house, without exception, is a building. Therefore, no houses can be vehicles.

syllogism: যেকোনো কিছু যা হাতি তা চার পায়ের প্রাণীও। পোকামাকড়ের একটি অংশ চার পায়ের প্রাণী। অতএব, কিছু পোকামাকড় হাতি নয়।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is an elephant is also a four-legged animal. A portion of insects are creatures that have four legs. Therefore, some insects are not elephants.

syllogism: Es gibt keine Bücher, die aus Papier bestehen. Es gibt kein einziges Taschenbuch, das ein Buch ist. Daraus folgt, dass einige Taschenbücher nicht aus Papier bestehen.
syllogism_orig: There are no books that are made of paper. There is not a single paperback that is a book. It follows, then, that some paperbacks are not made of paper.

syllogism: Hakuna mipira mikubwa ya gesi ambayo ni nyota. Jua zote bila ubaguzi ni mipira mikubwa ya gesi. Hakuna nyota inayoweza kuchukuliwa kuwa jua.
syllogism_orig: No giant balls of gas are stars. Suns are, without exception, giant balls of gas. No star can be considered a sun.

syllogism: È vero che nessun pesce vive nel mare. Ci sono dei pesci, e alcuni di essi sono salmoni. Sulla base di ciò, deve essere il caso che una certa quantità di salmoni non vive nel mare.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no fish live in the sea. There are fish, and some of them are salmons. Based on this, it must be the case that a certain amount of salmons do not live in the sea.

syllogism: ఏ చెట్టు కూడా పచ్చగా ఉండదు. ఏ కారు కూడా చెట్టు కాదు. కాబట్టి, ఏ కారు కూడా పచ్చగా ఉండదు.
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any tree is green. There is not a single car that is a tree. Consequently, there is no car that is green.

syllogism: Hakuna miamba ambayo ni vitu. Baadhi ya meza, kwa kushangaza, ni miamba. Hii inamaanisha kwamba sehemu ya meza si vitu.
syllogism_orig: There are no rocks that are objects. A few tables are, surprisingly, rocks. This means that a portion of tables are not objects.

syllogism: Некоторые планеты являются собаками. Все собаки являются существами. Следовательно, можно заключить, что некоторые существа являются планетами.
syllogism_orig: There are some planets that are dogs. All things that are dogs are beings. Hence, it can be concluded that some beings are planets.

syllogism: Alcuni pesci sono pinguini. Tutti i pinguini appartengono alla classe degli uccelli. Si deve concludere che alcuni uccelli sono pesci.
syllogism_orig: Some fish are penguins. All penguins belong to the class of birds. One must conclude that some birds are fish.

syllogism: 所有报纸都是动物，这是真的。有些杂志不是动物。因此，有些杂志不是报纸。
syllogism_orig: It is true that all newspapers are animals. There are some magazines that are not animals. Therefore, it is the case that some magazines are not newspapers.

syllogism: যে কোনো ব্যক্তি যিনি একজন ডাক্তার তিনি একটি মেঘ। প্রতিটি ডাক্তার একজন ডিগ্রিধারী ব্যক্তি। এটি প্রমাণ করে যে প্রতিটি ডিগ্রিধারী ব্যক্তি একটি মেঘ।
syllogism_orig: Any person who is a doctor is a cloud. Every single doctor is a person with a degree. This proves that every person with a degree is a cloud.

syllogism: Het is waar dat geen enkele vis een zwemmer is. Er zijn vissen, en sommige daarvan zijn tonijnen. Op basis hiervan moet het zo zijn dat een bepaald aantal tonijnen geen zwemmers zijn.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no fish is a swimmer. There are fish, and some of them are tuna. Based on this, it must be the case that a certain amount of tuna are not swimmers.

syllogism: Jedes einzelne Geschöpf, das ein Tier mit Flossen ist, ist ein Fisch. Es ist auch der Fall, dass einige Wale Fische sind. Dies führt zu dem Schluss, dass einige Wale Tiere mit Flossen sind.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature that is an animal with fins is a fish. It is also the case that some whales are fish. This leads to the conclusion that some whales are animals with fins.

syllogism: Il existe des animaux qui sont des mammifères. Ce qui est un chien est un animal. Par conséquent, tout chien est un mammifère.
syllogism_orig: There are some animals that are mammals. Something that is a dog is an animal. Consequently, every dog is a mammal.

syllogism: Всё, что является представителем семейства кошачьих, является млекопитающим. Нет кошек, которые являются представителями семейства кошачьих. Следовательно, нет кошек, которые являются млекопитающими.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a feline is a mammal. There are no cats that are felines. Thus, there are no cats that are mammals.

syllogism: Todo triângulo é um polígono. Não é o caso que algumas linhas são polígonos. Portanto, segue-se que algumas linhas não são triângulos.
syllogism_orig: Every single triangle is a polygon. It is not the case that some lines are polygons. Therefore, it follows that some lines are not triangles.

syllogism: Elke persoon die een dier is, is een levend wezen. Geen enkel gebouw is een dier. De conclusie dat geen enkel gebouw een levend wezen is, is onvermijdelijk.
syllogism_orig: Every single person who is an animal is a living thing. Not a single building is an animal. The conclusion that no buildings are living things is inescapable.

syllogism: Aucun chien n'est un chat. Tout ce qui est un oiseau est un chien. Donc, tout oiseau est un chat.
syllogism_orig: There are no dogs that are cats. Everything that is a bird is a dog. Thus, every bird is a cat.

syllogism: Qualsiasi oggetto che è un edificio è anche una struttura. Non esiste una singola struttura che sia una nuvola. Ne consegue che nessuna nuvola è un edificio.
syllogism_orig: Any object that is a building is also a structure. There is not a single structure that is a cloud. It follows that no cloud is a building.

syllogism: Algumas nuvens são casas. Uma casa é um edifício. Sendo assim, é necessariamente verdade que alguns edifícios são nuvens.
syllogism_orig: Some clouds are houses. A house is a building. As such, it is necessarily true that some buildings are clouds.

syllogism: Ninguna criatura que es un retriever es un perro. Todos los animales son retrievers. Debe ser el caso que ningún animal es un perro.
syllogism_orig: Not a single creature that is a retriever is a dog. Every single animal is a retriever. It must be the case that no animal is a dog.

syllogism: Cada cuadrado es un polígono. No hay polígonos que sean círculos. Por lo tanto, se puede concluir que algunos círculos no son cuadrados.
syllogism_orig: Every single square is a polygon. There are no polygons which are circles. Thus, it can be concluded that some circles are not squares.

syllogism: Некоторые картофелины не являются живыми существами. Каждая картофелина является человеком. Из этого логически следует, что некоторые люди не являются живыми существами.
syllogism_orig: Some things that are potatoes are not living things. Every single thing that is a potato is a human. A logical consequence of this is that some humans are not living things.

syllogism: Es verdad que todos los peces viven en el agua. Ningún ave es un pez. Por lo tanto, ningún ave vive en el agua.
syllogism_orig: It is true that all fish live in water. No birds are fish. Therefore, no bird lives in water.

syllogism: Todo personagem fictício é uma pedra. Existem personagens fictícios que são animais. Portanto, uma parte dos animais são pedras.
syllogism_orig: Every fictional characters is a stone. There are fictional characters which are animals. Thus, a portion of animals are stones.

syllogism: Um inseto nunca é um aracnídeo. Existem aranhas que são aracnídeos. A única conclusão a tirar é que algumas aranhas não são insetos.
syllogism_orig: An insect is never an arachnid. There are spiders that are arachnids. The only conclusion to draw is that some spiders are not insects.

syllogism: এটা সত্য নয় যে কোনো কুকুর একটি প্রাণী। যা স্তন্যপায়ী তার কিছুই কুকুর নয়। এটি এই সিদ্ধান্তে পৌঁছায় যে কোনো স্তন্যপায়ী প্রাণী নয়।
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any dog is an animal. Nothing that is a mammal is a dog. This leads to the conclusion that no mammal is an animal.

syllogism: Er zijn geen tafels die levende wezens zijn. Het is niet waar dat enige plant een tafel is. Het is het geval dat sommige planten tafels zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no tables that are living things. It is not true that any plant is a table. It is the case that some plants are tables.

syllogism: Schriftwerke sind in keiner Weise Gegenstände mit bedruckten Seiten. Alles, was ein Buch ist, ist ein Gegenstand mit bedruckten Seiten. Bücher sind keine Schriftwerke.
syllogism_orig: Written works are in no way items with printed pages. Everything that is a book is an item with printed pages. Books are not written works.

syllogism: 所有有刺的植物都不是花。有一些玫瑰被认为是有刺的植物。这证明了有些玫瑰不是花。
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a plant with thorns is not a flower. A certain number of roses are considered plants with thorns. This demonstrates that some roses are not flowers.

syllogism: Kila kitu cha angani ambacho ni sayari ni mchemraba. Sehemu ya vitu vya angani ni sayari. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya vitu vya angani ni michemraba.
syllogism_orig: Any celestial body which is a planet is a cube. A portion of celestial bodies are planets. Consequently, some celestial bodies are cubes.

syllogism: Todo cuadrado es una forma que también es un rectángulo. Todo rectángulo es un polígono. Se sigue que algunos polígonos son cuadrados.
syllogism_orig: Every square is a shape that is also a rectangle. Every rectangle is a polygon. It follows that some polygons are squares.

syllogism: Ни одно дерево не является кустарником. Известно, что некоторые дубы являются деревьями. Следовательно, некоторые дубы не являются кустарниками.
syllogism_orig: There is not a single tree that is a shrub. It is known that some oaks are trees. Consequently, some oaks are not shrubs.

syllogism: Toda persona que es un humano es un robot. El conjunto de personas no contiene robots. Es el caso que algunas personas no son humanos.
syllogism_orig: Any person who is a human is a robot. The set of people contains no robots. It is the case that some people are not humans.

syllogism: Kitu chochote ambacho ni tofaha si tunda la machungwa. Kundi la vitu vinavyojulikana kama matunda lina baadhi ya wanachama ambao ni matunda ya machungwa. Matokeo ya hili ni kwamba baadhi ya matunda si matofaha.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is an apple is not a citrus fruit. The group of items known as fruits has some members that are citrus fruits. The result of this is that some fruits are not apples.

syllogism: Leeuwen zijn geen gazellen. Alle Afrikaanse leeuwen zijn dingen die leeuwen zijn. Hieruit volgt dat er enkele Afrikaanse leeuwen zijn die geen gazellen zijn.
syllogism_orig: Lions are not gazelles. All African lions are things that are lions. It follows that there are some African lions that are not gazelles.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క ఆలోచన ఒక చెట్టు. ప్రతి ఒక్క ఆలోచన ఒక జంతువు. కాబట్టి, చెట్లు అయిన జంతువులు ఉన్నాయి.
syllogism_orig: Every single idea is a tree. Every single idea is an animal. Therefore, there are animals that are trees.

syllogism: যেকোনো কিছু যা কাটলারি তা আসবাবপত্র। এমন কোনো কাটলারি নেই যা একই সাথে চামচও। এটা সত্য যে কিছু কাটলারি চামচ নয়।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is cutlery is furniture. There are no pieces of cutlery which are also spoons. It is the case that some cutlery is not a spoon.

syllogism: Todo mamífero é um animal. Nenhum peixe é um mamífero. Consequentemente, nenhum peixe é um animal.
syllogism_orig: Every single mammal is an animal. There are no fish which are mammals. Consequently, there are no fish which are animals.

syllogism: যা কিছু কুকুরজাতীয় তার কিছুই বিড়াল নয়। একটি নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যক কুকুর কুকুরজাতীয়। অতএব, কিছু কুকুর বিড়াল।
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a canine is a cat. A certain number of dogs are canines. Thus, some dogs are cats.

syllogism: Qualche animale che è un rettile non è un anfibio. È noto che una parte dei coccodrilli sono rettili. Da ciò, possiamo dedurre che alcuni coccodrilli non sono anfibi.
syllogism_orig: Some animal that is a reptile is not an amphibian. It is known that a portion of crocodiles are reptiles. From this, we can deduce that some crocodiles are not amphibians.

syllogism: Cada martillo es una herramienta. No hay clavos que sean martillos. De esto se sigue que cada clavo es una herramienta.
syllogism_orig: Every single hammer is a tool. There are no nails that are hammers. It follows from this that every nail is a tool.

syllogism: Kein einzelnes Gewächs ist ein Baum. Einige wenige Kiefern werden als Gewächse klassifiziert. Es ist daher eine Tatsache, dass einige Kiefern keine Bäume sind.
syllogism_orig: No single plant is a tree. A select few pines are classified as plants. It is therefore a fact that some pines are not trees.

syllogism: జంతువు అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ఆలోచన. కుక్కలు అయిన ఆలోచనలు ఏవీ లేవు. ఇది తప్పనిసరిగా కొన్ని కుక్కలు జంతువులు కావు అని సూచిస్తుంది.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a animal is an idea. There are no ideas that are dogs. This necessarily suggests that some dogs are not animals.

syllogism: Qualsiasi cosa che sia una bicicletta è un veicolo. È noto che nessun camion è una bicicletta. Questo porta alla conclusione che nessun camion è un veicolo.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a bicycle is a vehicle. It is known that no trucks are bicycles. This leads to the conclusion that no truck is a vehicle.

syllogism: Alles wat een ster is, is een lepel. Er bestaan geen lepels die zonnen zijn. Hieruit kunnen we afleiden dat sommige zonnen geen sterren zijn.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a star is a spoon. There exist no spoons that are suns. From this, we can deduce that some suns are not stars.

syllogism: Todo lo que es una fruta es un sentimiento. No hay sentimientos que sean manzanas. Como resultado, podemos concluir que algunas manzanas no son frutas.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a fruit is a feeling. There are no feelings which are apples. As a result, we can conclude that some apples are not fruits.

syllogism: Ogni singolo animale è un essere vivente. Tutto ciò che è un umano è anche un essere vivente. Di conseguenza, ogni umano è un animale.
syllogism_orig: Every single animal is a living thing. Everything that is a human is also a living thing. Consequently, every human is an animal.

syllogism: Hay algunas criaturas que son animales y no son vertebrados. Todos los gatos son también vertebrados. Esto lleva a la conclusión de que hay algunos gatos que son animales.
syllogism_orig: There are some creatures that are animals and not vertebrates. All cats are also vertebrates. This leads to the conclusion that there are some cats which are animals.

syllogism: Любой огонь является замороженным. Существуют некоторые языки пламени, которые являются огнём. Следовательно, подразумевается, что некоторые языки пламени являются замороженными.
syllogism_orig: Any fire is frozen. There are some flames that are fire. Therefore, it is implied that some flames are frozen.

syllogism: Het is volledig onjuist dat enig wezen dat een vogel is, een vis is. Er bestaat een groep vogels die ook pinguïns zijn. Een geldige gevolgtrekking is dat sommige pinguïns vissen zijn.
syllogism_orig: It is completely false that any creature which is a bird is a fish. There exists a group of birds who are also penguins. A valid inference is that some penguins are fish.

syllogism: 没有三角形是正方形。每一个三角形都是多边形。有些多边形不是正方形。
syllogism_orig: There are no triangles which are squares. Every single triangle is a polygon. It's the case that some polygons are not squares.

syllogism: రాళ్ళు అయిన మేఘాలు ఏవీ లేవు. పర్వతాలు అయిన రాళ్ళు ఏవీ లేవు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని పర్వతాలు మేఘాలు.
syllogism_orig: There are no clouds that are rocks. There are no rocks that are mountains. Therefore, some mountains are clouds.

syllogism: Tudo o que é um mamífero é um animal. Todo cão é um animal. Isso significa que todos os cães são mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a mammal is an animal. Every single dog is an animal. This means that all dogs are mammals.

syllogism: Toutes les choses qui sont des nombres sont des animaux. Toutes les choses qui sont des nombres sont des plantes. Il s'ensuit que quelques plantes sont des animaux.
syllogism_orig: All things which are numbers are animals. All things which are numbers are plants. It follows that some plants are animals.

syllogism: Nenhum livro é um edifício. Algumas coisas feitas de papel são livros. Disso, conclui-se que alguns edifícios são feitos de papel.
syllogism_orig: No books are buildings. Some things made of paper are books. From this, it is concluded that some buildings are made of paper.

syllogism: O conjunto dos automóveis e o conjunto dos veículos autopropulsados são inteiramente separados. A categoria inteira dos carros é composta por veículos autopropulsados. Automóveis não são carros.
syllogism_orig: The set of automobiles and the set of self-propelled vehicles are entirely separate. The entire category of cars is composed of self-propelled vehicles. Automobiles are not cars.

syllogism: Nessun leone è un erbivoro. Ogni leone è un predatore. Pertanto, possiamo concludere che alcuni predatori non sono erbivori.
syllogism_orig: There are no lions which are herbivores. Every single lion is a predator. Therefore, we can conclude that some predators are not herbivores.

syllogism: క్రింది అనువాదం:  పక్షులైన క్షీరదాలు ఏవీ లేవు కాదు - చిలుకలైన క్షీరదాలు ఏవీ లేవు. కొన్ని పక్షులు చిలుకలు. దీని అర్థం ప్రతి పక్షి ఒక క్షీరదం.  I need to redo this more carefully:  క్షీరదాలైన చిలుకలు ఏవీ లేవు. కొన్ని పక్షులు చిలుకలు. దీని అర్థం ప్రతి పక్షి ఒక క్షీరదం.
syllogism_orig: There are no parrots which are mammals. Some birds are parrots. This implies that every bird is a mammal.

syllogism: Elke dokter is een professional. De verzameling kinderen bevat geen professionals. Minstens één kind is geen dokter.
syllogism_orig: Every doctor is a professional. The set of children does not contain professionals. At least one child is not a doctor.

syllogism: ప్రతి పులి ఒక పిల్లి జాతి జంతువు. అన్ని పులులు కూడా క్షీరదాలు. కాబట్టి, అన్ని క్షీరదాలు పిల్లి జాతి జంతువులు.
syllogism_orig: Every tiger is a feline. All tigers are also mammals. Therefore, all mammals are felines.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క శాస్త్రవేత్త ఇంజనీర్ అనేది నిజం కాదు. ప్రతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఒక ఎలివేటర్. దీని నుండి కొన్ని ఎలివేటర్లు ఇంజనీర్లు అని తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: It is not the case that every single scientist is an engineer. Every scientist is an elevator. It follows from this that some elevators are engineers.

syllogism: Hay algunos reptiles que son animales. Cada serpiente es un reptil. Por lo tanto, todas las serpientes son animales.
syllogism_orig: There are some reptile that are animals. Every single snake is a reptile. It is therefore the case that all snakes are animals.

syllogism: যেকোনো কিছু যা পাখি তা প্রাণী। যেকোনো কিছু যা জেব্রা তা প্রাণী। সকল পাখি জেব্রা।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a bird is an animal. Everything that is a zebra is an animal. All birds are zebras.

syllogism: ఉపగ్రహమైన ప్రతిదీ చంద్రుడు. ఉపగ్రహాలైన గ్రహాలు ఉన్నాయి. అన్ని గ్రహాలు చంద్రులు అని తప్పనిసరిగా అనుసరించాలి.
syllogism_orig: Anything and everything that is a satellite is a moon. There are satellites that are planets. It must follow that all planets are moons.

syllogism: Aucun animal qui est un poisson n'a de bec. Tous les oiseaux sont des animaux qui ont un bec. Par conséquent, on peut dire que certains oiseaux ne sont pas des poissons.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are fish that have beaks. All birds are animals that have beaks. Consequently, it can be said that some birds are not fish.

syllogism: Kuna baadhi ya wanasayansi ambao ni wahandisi. Ni ukweli unaojulikana kwamba baadhi ya wanasayansi pia ni madaktari. Kutokana na hili, inapendekezwa kwamba baadhi ya madaktari ni wahandisi.
syllogism_orig: There are some scientists who are engineers. It is a known fact that some scientists are also doctors. From this, it is suggested that some doctors are engineers.

syllogism: Un certo numero di auto sono veicoli. Tutti i veicoli sono considerati mezzi di trasporto. Ne consegue logicamente che alcuni mezzi di trasporto sono auto.
syllogism_orig: A certain number of cars are vehicles. All vehicles are considered modes of transportation. It logically follows that some modes of transportation are cars.

syllogism: Tout fruit est un aliment. Il est vrai qu'aucune pomme n'est un aliment. Cela signifie qu'aucune pomme n'est un fruit.
syllogism_orig: Any fruit is a food. It is the case that no apple is a food. This means that no apple is a fruit.

syllogism: 没有一个医生是工程师。在医生中，有一些是研究人员。由此，我们可以合乎逻辑地得出结论：有一些研究人员不是工程师。
syllogism_orig: Not a single person who is a doctor is also an engineer. Among the group of people who are doctors, some are researchers. From this, we can logically conclude that there are some researchers who are not engineers.

syllogism: Ни один круг не является круглой фигурой. Все кольца являются кругами. Следовательно, некоторые кольца не являются круглыми фигурами.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no circles are round shapes. All of the things that are rings are circles. Thus, some rings are not round shapes.

syllogism: Het is waar dat geen katten honden zijn. Er zijn enkele mensen die geen honden zijn. Hieruit volgt dat enkele mensen geen katten zijn.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no cats are dogs. There are some people who are not dogs. It follows that some people are not cats.

syllogism: అన్ని ఇళ్ళు నిర్మాణాలు. వంతెనలు ఏవీ ఇళ్ళు కావు. కాబట్టి, ఏ వంతెన కూడా నిర్మాణం కాదు.
syllogism_orig: All houses are structures. There are no bridges that are houses. Therefore, no bridge is a structure.

syllogism: Kila kitu ambacho ni mtu kimetengenezwa kwa mbao. Bila ubaguzi, watoto wote ni watu. Kwa hivyo, hakuna watoto ambao hawajatengenezwa kwa mbao.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a person is made of wood. Without exception, all children are people. Therefore, there are no children who are not made of wood.

syllogism: Ogni singolo cane è un mammifero. Non esistono cani che siano pesci. Pertanto, non esistono pesci che siano mammiferi.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a mammal. There are no dogs that are fish. Therefore, there are no fish that are mammals.

syllogism: ఆలోచనలు అయిన వస్తువులు మెదడులో విద్యుత్ సంకేతాలు కావు. ప్రతి ఒక్క ఆలోచన (idea) ఒక తలంపు (thought). కాబట్టి, కొన్ని ఆలోచనలు (ideas) మెదడులో విద్యుత్ సంకేతాలు కావు.
syllogism_orig: Things that are thoughts are not electrical signals in the brain. Every single idea is a thought. Therefore, some ideas are not electrical signals in the brain.

syllogism: É o caso que todo e qualquer livro pesa uma tonelada. Uma parte dos romances são livros. Consequentemente, alguns romances pesam uma tonelada.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that every single book weighs a ton. A portion of novels are books. Consequently, some novels weigh a ton.

syllogism: Es gibt keine fleißigen Menschen, die auch faule Menschen sind. Einige Studenten sind fleißige Menschen. Es wird geschlussfolgert, dass einige Studenten faule Menschen sind.
syllogism_orig: There are no hard workers who are also lazy people. Some students are hard workers. It is concluded that some students are lazy people.

syllogism: Nessun anfibio terrestre è in grado di sopravvivere in acqua salata. Ogni salamandra è, senza eccezione, un anfibio terrestre. Ciò implica che nessuna salamandra è in grado di vivere in acqua salata.
syllogism_orig: Not a single land-dwelling amphibian is able to survive in saltwater. Every salamander is, without exception, a land-dwelling amphibian. This implies that no salamander is able to live in saltwater.

syllogism: Jede einzelne Frucht ist ein Ding, das auf Bäumen wächst. Alle Äpfel sind Dinge, die auf Bäumen wachsen. Mindestens ein Apfel ist eine Frucht.
syllogism_orig: Every single fruit is a thing that grows on trees. All apples are things that grow on trees. At least one apple is a fruit.

syllogism: Todo avião é uma nuvem. É verdade que todo pássaro é uma nuvem. Isso significa que todo pássaro é um avião.
syllogism_orig: Every airplane is a cloud. It is true that every bird is a cloud. This means that every single bird is an airplane.

syllogism: Каждое здание сделано из конфет. Нет ни одного дома, который не является зданием. Некоторое количество домов сделано из конфет.
syllogism_orig: Every single building is made of candy. There are no houses that are not buildings. A certain number of houses are made of candy.

syllogism: Er zijn geen groenten die fruit zijn. Het is ook waar dat geen mineralen groenten zijn. Hieruit wordt gesuggereerd dat sommige mineralen fruit zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no vegetables that are fruits. It is also true that no minerals are vegetables. From this, it is suggested that some minerals are fruits.

syllogism: Todo lo que es un vehículo es también una máquina. Hay un subconjunto de máquinas que son coches. Por lo tanto, algunos coches no son vehículos.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a vehicle is also a machine. There is a subset of machines that are cars. Therefore, some cars are not vehicles.

syllogism: Nessuna università è una pianta. Almeno un albero è una pianta. Almeno un albero è una università.
syllogism_orig: There are no universities which are plants. At least one tree is a plant. At least one tree is a university.

syllogism: এটি সত্য যে কিছু ছাত্র ক্রীড়াবিদ। কিছু লম্বা মানুষ আছে যারা ক্রীড়াবিদ। এটি যৌক্তিকভাবে অনুসরণ করে যে কিছু লম্বা মানুষ ছাত্র নয়।
syllogism_orig: It is true that some students are athletes. There are some tall people which are athletes. It logically follows that some tall people are not students.

syllogism: Nada que possa ser considerado um corpo celeste é um objeto que orbita uma estrela. Todo planeta é um objeto que orbita uma estrela. Não existem planetas que também sejam corpos celestes.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that can be considered a celestial body is an object that orbits a star. Every planet is an object that orbits a star. There exist no planets that are also celestial bodies.

syllogism: Ogni oggetto che è un tavolo è un tipo di mobile. Non esistono mobili che siano automobili. Da ciò, dobbiamo concludere che alcune automobili non sono tavoli.
syllogism_orig: Every object that is a table is a type of furniture. There exist no pieces of furniture that are cars. From this, we must conclude that some cars are not tables.

syllogism: ఏ దెయ్యం కూడా అమరమైనది కాదు. ఏ మానవుడూ దెయ్యం కాదు. దీని నుండి ఏ మానవుడూ అమరమైనవాడు కాదు అని తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no ghost is immortal. There is not a single human that is a ghost. It follows that no human is immortal.

syllogism: 凡是鸟都不是动物。在麻雀中，有些是动物。因此，有些麻雀不是鸟。
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a bird is not an animal. Of the items that are sparrows, some are animals. It must be the case that some sparrows are not birds.

syllogism: Рептилии — это класс животных, который не включает амфибий. Все лягушки являются амфибиями. Группа лягушек и группа рептилий не имеют общих членов.
syllogism_orig: Reptiles are a class of animal which does not contain any amphibians. All things that are frogs are amphibians. The group of frogs and the group of reptiles have no members in common.

syllogism: పనిముట్లు మరియు పిడులు కలిగిన వస్తువులు ఏవీ లేవు. పిడులు కలిగిన వస్తువుల మొత్తం సమూహం సుత్తులతో కూడి ఉంది. పనిముట్లలో కొంత భాగం సుత్తులు.
syllogism_orig: There are no objects that are both tools and have handles. The entire set of objects with handles is composed of hammers. A portion of tools are hammers.

syllogism: 大陆的集合与国家的集合互不相交。加拿大不是大陆。因此，加拿大是国家。
syllogism_orig: The group of continents and the group of countries are mutually exclusive. Canada is not a continent. Therefore, Canada is a country.

syllogism: Aucun humain n'est un arbre. Tous les arbres sont des femmes. Il en découle logiquement que quelques femmes ne sont pas des humains.
syllogism_orig: Not a single human is a tree. The entire set of trees is composed of women. It logically follows that some women are not human.

syllogism: Geen enkel zoogdier is een haai. Sommige haaien zijn vissen. Dus zijn sommige vissen geen zoogdieren.
syllogism_orig: There is no mammal that is a shark. Some of the sharks are fish. Therefore, some fish are not mammals.

syllogism: Il existe des membres du groupe qui sont des chanteurs. Tous les membres du groupe sont considérés comme des musiciens. Il s'ensuit que certains musiciens sont des chanteurs.
syllogism_orig: There are some band members who are singers. All band members are considered musicians. It follows that some musicians are singers.

syllogism: Ogni singolo uccello è un animale. Non esistono animali che siano minerali. Questo dimostra che alcuni minerali non sono uccelli.
syllogism_orig: Every single bird is an animal. There are no animals that are minerals. This proves that some minerals are not birds.

syllogism: Miongoni mwa watu ambao ni wanasayansi, kuna baadhi ambao pia ni waprogramu. Miongoni mwa watu ambao ni wanamuziki, baadhi yao ni waprogramu. Kwa hivyo, inafuata kwamba baadhi ya watu ambao ni wanamuziki pia ni wanasayansi.
syllogism_orig: Among the people who are scientists, there are some who are also programmers. Of the people who are musicians, a number of them are programmers. It therefore stands that some people who are musicians are also scientists.

syllogism: Kila ndege ni samaki. Hakuna samaki ambao ni shomoro. Hii inapendekeza kwa lazima kwamba baadhi ya shomoro si ndege.
syllogism_orig: Every bird is a fish. There are no fish which are sparrows. This necessarily suggests that some sparrows are not birds.

syllogism: Er zijn geen shirts die groenten zijn. Sommige kleding is shirts. Dit impliceert dat elk kledingstuk een groente is.
syllogism_orig: There are no shirts which are vegetables. Some clothing is shirts. This implies that every piece of clothing is a vegetable.

syllogism: প্রতিটি বাড়ি একটি ভবন। কিছু বিদ্যালয় ভবন হিসেবে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ। ফলস্বরূপ, সব বিদ্যালয় বাড়ি নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every single house is a building. A few schools are classified as buildings. As a result, not all schools are houses.

syllogism: Множество людей является подмножеством множества смертных. По крайней мере один робот не является смертным. Существует по крайней мере один робот, который не является человеком.
syllogism_orig: The set of humans is a subset of the set of mortals. At least one robot is not a mortal. There is at least one robot who is not a human.

syllogism: প্রতিটি তারা একটি উজ্জ্বল মহাজাগতিক বস্তু। কিছু গ্রহ আছে যেগুলি উজ্জ্বল নয়। এটি সত্য যে কিছু গ্রহ তারা নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every star is a luminous celestial body. There are some planets that are not luminous. It is the case that some planets are not stars.

syllogism: Стулья никоим образом не являются мебелью. Всё, что является стулом, является объектом. Существуют некоторые объекты, которые не являются мебелью.
syllogism_orig: Chairs are in no way furniture. Everything that is a chair is an object. There are some objects that are not furniture.

syllogism: Algum item que é um animal não é um mamífero. Alguns cães são mamíferos. Portanto, todos os cães podem ser considerados animais.
syllogism_orig: Some item that is an animal is not a mammal. Some dogs are mammals. Therefore, all dogs can be said to be animals.

syllogism: Tutte le cose che sono leoni sono felini. Tutte le cose che sono gatti sono felini. Si può dedurre che ci sono gatti che sono leoni.
syllogism_orig: All of the things that are lions are felines. All of the things that are cats are felines. It can be deduced that there are cats that are lions.

syllogism: Il est impossible qu'une araignée soit un oiseau. Une portion des araignées sont considérées comme des arachnides. Il est nécessairement le cas que certains arachnides ne sont pas des oiseaux.
syllogism_orig: It is impossible for a spider to be a bird. A portion of spiders are considered arachnids. It is necessarily the case that some arachnids are not birds.

syllogism: Kila ndege ni mwenye uti wa mgongo. Kila ndege ni mnyama mwenye mbawa. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya wanyama wenye mbawa lazima wawe wenye uti wa mgongo.
syllogism_orig: Each bird is a vertebrate. Each bird is an animal that has wings. So, some animals with wings must be vertebrates.

syllogism: 有些首都是被污染的。所有首都，按定义，都是城市。因此必须得出结论：有些城市是被污染的。
syllogism_orig: There are some capitals that are polluted. All capitals are, by definition, cities. One must conclude that some cities are polluted.

syllogism: Hay algunas mesas que son felicidad. Todo lo que es felicidad es una emoción. En consecuencia, algunas emociones son mesas.
syllogism_orig: There are some tables that are happiness. Anything that is happiness is an emotion. Consequently, some emotions are tables.

syllogism: Alles, was ein Welpe ist, ist giftig. Einige Welpen werden als Haustiere gehalten. Daraus folgt, dass eine gewisse Anzahl von Haustieren giftig ist.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a puppy is venomous. A few puppies are kept as pets. This implies that a certain number of pets are venomous.

syllogism: Hay algunas criaturas que son mamíferos y también animales. Entre el grupo de criaturas que son tigres, algunas son animales. Se sigue que al menos algunos tigres no son mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: There are some creatures that are mammals and also animals. Among the group of creatures that are tigers, some are animals. It follows that at least some tigers are not mammals.

syllogism: Aucun légume n'est un type de viande. Il est vrai que chaque viande est un aliment. Cela prouve que certains légumes sont des aliments.
syllogism_orig: No vegetable is a type of meat. It is true that every single meat is a food. This proves that some vegetables are food.

syllogism: అన్ని క్షీరదాలు సజీవ వస్తువులు అనేది వాస్తవం. కొన్ని జంతువులు జీబ్రాలు. కాబట్టి, ప్రతి ఒక్క జీబ్రా ఒక సజీవ వస్తువు.
syllogism_orig: It is a fact that all mammals are animate objects. There are some animals which are zebras. Therefore, every single zebra is an animate object.

syllogism: Il est vrai qu'aucun insecte n'est un mammifère. Chaque insecte est un animal. Pour cette raison, chaque animal est un mammifère.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no insect is a mammal. Every single insect is an animal. For this reason, every animal is a mammal.

syllogism: కారు అయిన ప్రతి వస్తువుకు ఇంజిన్ ఉంటుంది. కొన్ని మోటారు వాహనాలు కార్లు. కాబట్టి, అన్ని మోటారు వాహనాలకు ఇంజిన్లు ఉంటాయి.
syllogism_orig: Every object that is a car has an engine. Some motorized vehicles are cars. Therefore, all motorized vehicles have engines.

syllogism: Верно, что всё, что является яблоком, является съедобной вещью. Каждое яблоко является фруктом. Из этого следует, что некоторые фрукты являются съедобными вещами.
syllogism_orig: It is true that anything that is an apple is an edible thing. Every apple is a fruit. It follows that some fruits are edible things.

syllogism: কিছু জিনিস আছে যেগুলো নদী, যেগুলো মহাসাগর নয়। যেকোনো কিছু যা নদী তা জলাশয়। এর যৌক্তিক পরিণতি হলো কিছু জলাশয় মহাসাগর নয়।
syllogism_orig: There exist some things which are rivers, that are not oceans. Anything that is a river is a body of water. A logical consequence of this is that some bodies of water are not oceans.

syllogism: Todo pájaro es un animal. Todos los humanos también son animales. Por lo tanto, todos los humanos deben ser pájaros.
syllogism_orig: Every bird is an animal. All humans are animals as well. Therefore, all humans must be birds.

syllogism: Молотки — это предметы, которые являются инструментами. Ни одна перчатка не является инструментом. Из этого можно заключить, что ни одна перчатка не является молотком.
syllogism_orig: Hammers are items that are tools. It is the case that no glove is a tool. It can be concluded that no glove is a hammer.

syllogism: Все, что является призраками, является научными фактами. Все, что является призраками, является мифическими существами. Следовательно, некоторые мифические существа являются научными фактами.
syllogism_orig: All things which are ghosts are scientific facts. All things which are ghosts are mythical beings. It follows that some mythical beings are scientific facts.

syllogism: প্রতিটি বস্তু যা একটি ফুল তা একটি প্রাণী। যেকোনো কিছু যা একটি গোলাপ তা একটি বস্তু যা একটি ফুল। এর অর্থ হলো প্রতিটি গোলাপ একটি প্রাণী।
syllogism_orig: Every object that is a flower is an animal. Anything that is a rose is an object that is a flower. This means that every rose is an animal.

syllogism: 并非所有文具都能用于书写。所有铅笔都是文具。因此，没有铅笔能用于书写。
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any stationery item can be used for writing. All pencils are items of stationery. Therefore, no pencil is able to be used for writing.

syllogism: Kila tufaha ni mboga. Chochote ambacho ni tufaha ni tunda. Kutokana na hili, inaweza kusemwa kwamba baadhi ya matunda ni mboga.
syllogism_orig: Every single apple is a vegetable. Anything that is an apple is a fruit. From this, it can be stated that some fruits are vegetables.

syllogism: Er zijn geen amfibieën die niet zowel op het land als in het water leven. Elke kikker is een amfibie. Er bestaat minstens één kikker die zowel op het land als in het water leeft.
syllogism_orig: There are no amphibians that do not live on both land and in water. Every single frog is an amphibian. There exists at least one frog that lives on land and in water.

syllogism: Hakuna waridi ambao ni mboga. Kiasi fulani cha waridi ni maua. Hii inamaanisha kimantiki kwamba baadhi ya maua si mboga.
syllogism_orig: There are no roses that are vegetables. A certain quantity of roses are flowers. This logically implies that some flowers are not vegetables.

syllogism: Jede Katzenartige ist ein Tier. Es gibt eine Teilmenge von Tieren, die aus Säugetieren besteht. Ein Teil der Säugetiere sind keine Katzenartigen.
syllogism_orig: Every feline is an animal. There is a subset of animals that is composed of mammals. A portion of mammals are not felines.

syllogism: భవనాలు ఏవీ మొక్కల సమూహంలో కనుగొనబడవు. చెట్ల వర్గం పూర్తిగా మొక్కలతో రూపొందించబడింది. భవనాలు మరియు చెట్లు పూర్తిగా వేర్వేరు వర్గాలు.
syllogism_orig: No buildings are found within the group of plants. The category of trees is entirely made up of plants. Buildings and trees are completely separate categories.

syllogism: Ningún oro es plata. La plata es, sin excepción, un metal. Varios metales son oro.
syllogism_orig: No gold is silver. Silver is, without exception, a metal. A number of metals are gold.

syllogism: గ్రహం అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు. భూమి అయినవి గ్రహాలు కానివి ఏవీ లేవు. కాబట్టి, కనీసం కొంత భూమి ఒక ఖగోళ వస్తువు.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a planet is a celestial body. There are no things that are Earth that are not planets. Therefore, at least some Earth is a celestial body.

syllogism: Ni kweli kwamba hakuna ndege ambaye ni mdudu. Kila mdudu ni mamalia. Hii inathibitisha kwamba mamalia wote ni ndege.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no bird is an insect. Every single insect is a mammal. This proves that all mammals are birds.

syllogism: Een computer is nooit een tablet. Alle tablets zijn, zonder uitzondering, elektronische apparaten. Een deel van de elektronische apparaten bestaat niet uit computers.
syllogism_orig: A computer is never a tablet. All of the tablets are, without exception, electronic devices. A subset of electronic devices is not composed of computers.

syllogism: ఏ ఇన్‌పుట్ పరికరం టైపింగ్ కోసం ఉపయోగించబడుతుందనేది నిజం కాదు. ప్రతి కీబోర్డు ఒక ఇన్‌పుట్ పరికరం. కాబట్టి ఏ కీబోర్డు టైపింగ్ కోసం ఉపయోగించబడదు అనేది వాస్తవం.
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any input device is used for typing. Each and every keyboard is an input device. It is therefore a fact that no keyboard is used for typing.

syllogism: O grupo de aves é um subconjunto do grupo de criaturas com penas. Pelo menos um inseto não é uma criatura com penas. Nem todo inseto é uma ave.
syllogism_orig: The group of birds is a subset of the group of creatures with feathers. At least one insect is not a creature with feathers. Not every insect is a bird.

syllogism: Todo zapato es un tipo de calzado. Nada que sea una sandalia es un tipo de calzado. Es el caso que ninguna sandalia es un zapato.
syllogism_orig: Every shoe is a type of footwear. Nothing that is a sandal is a type of footwear. It is the case that no sandal is a shoe.

syllogism: Er zijn enkele groenten die appels zijn. Alles wat een appel is, is een aquatisch zoogdier. Dit impliceert noodzakelijkerwijs dat enkele aquatische zoogdieren groenten zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are some vegetables which are apples. Everything that is an apple is an aquatic mammal. This necessitates that some aquatic mammals are vegetables.

syllogism: Всё, что является животным, является нелетающим. Каждая птица является животным. Нет ни одной птицы, которая не является нелетающей.
syllogism_orig: Anything which is an animal is a flightless thing. Every single bird is an animal. There are no birds that are not flightless.

syllogism: Il n'existe aucune créature qui soit à la fois poisson et reptile. Aucun lézard n'est poisson. Il s'ensuit donc que certains lézards sont des reptiles.
syllogism_orig: There exist no creatures that are both fish and reptiles. There are no lizards which are fish. It is therefore the case that some lizards are reptiles.

syllogism: 没有鸟是哺乳动物。已知有些宠物是哺乳动物。因此，有些宠物是鸟。
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a bird is also a mammal. It is known that some pets are mammals. Consequently, some pets are birds.

syllogism: Alle Dinge, die Fenster sind, sind Tiere. Alle Dinge, die Türen sind, sind Tiere. Es lässt sich ableiten, dass es Türen gibt, die Fenster sind.
syllogism_orig: All of the things that are windows are animals. All of the things that are doors are animals. It can be deduced that there are doors that are windows.

syllogism: Het is een feit dat elke frisdrank een vloeistof is. Evenzo is het waar dat al het water vloeistof is. Daarom is beweerd dat al het water frisdrank is.
syllogism_orig: It is a fact that every single soda is a liquid. Likewise, it is true that all water is liquid. Therefore, it has been asserted that every bit of water is soda.

syllogism: Kila kimiminika ni chenye unyevu. Vitu vigumu vyote pia ni vyenye unyevu. Kwa hivyo, hakuna kitu kigumu ambacho si kimiminika.
syllogism_orig: Every single liquid is wet. All solids are also wet. Therefore, nothing that is a solid is not a liquid.

syllogism: Il est vrai que tout ce qui est un soleil est une étoile. Il est également vrai que toutes les étoiles sont des corps célestes. Ainsi, on conclut que tous les corps célestes sont des soleils.
syllogism_orig: It is true that everything that is a sun is a star. It is also true that all stars are celestial bodies. Thus, it is concluded that all celestial bodies are suns.

syllogism: Kila kitu ambacho ni binadamu ni mamalia. Kuna nyani wengine ambao ni mamalia. Nyani wengine si mamalia.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a human is a mammal. There are some apes that are mammals. Some apes are not mammals.

syllogism: Toda fruta contiene semillas. Todo lo que es una manzana es una fruta. Varias manzanas contienen semillas.
syllogism_orig: Every single fruit contains seeds. Anything that is an apple is a fruit. A number of apples contain seeds.

syllogism: పొదలు అయిన వాటిలో ఏవీ 20 అడుగుల కంటే ఎత్తైన మొక్కలు కావు. చెట్ల వర్గానికి చెందిన ఏదైనా 20 అడుగుల కంటే ఎత్తైన మొక్క. చెట్లు మరియు పొదలు ఒకే సమూహానికి చెందవు.
syllogism_orig: None of the things that are shrubs are plants over 20 feet tall. Anything that belongs to the class of trees is a plant over 20 feet tall. Trees and shrubs do not belong to the same group.

syllogism: Sommige planeten zijn dieren. Alle dieren zijn levende wezens. Bijgevolg zijn sommige levende wezens planeten.
syllogism_orig: Some of the planets are animals. All animals are living things. As a result, some living things are planets.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క పూజారి ఒక వ్యక్తి. అన్ని పూజారులు మానవులు. దీని నుండి ప్రతి మానవుడు ఒక వ్యక్తి అని తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: Every single priest is a person. All priests are human. It follows from this that every human is a person.

syllogism: Gari kamwe si ndege. Pia ni kweli kwamba hakuna mashua ambayo ni ndege. Kwa hivyo, mashua zote ni magari.
syllogism_orig: A car is never an airplane. It is also the case that no boat is an airplane. Consequently, all boats are cars.

syllogism: কোনো মাছ স্তন্যপায়ী নয়। কোনো বিড়াল মাছ হিসেবে বিবেচিত নয়। কিছু বিড়ালজাতীয় প্রাণী স্তন্যপায়ী নয়।
syllogism_orig: There are no fish which are mammals. No cats are considered fish. Some felines are not mammals.

syllogism: È una certezza che ogni singolo insegnante è un essere umano. È anche vero che alcuni individui istruiti sono esseri umani. Su questa base, è stato affermato che alcuni individui istruiti sono insegnanti.
syllogism_orig: It is a certainty that every single teacher is a human being. It is also true that a few educated people are human beings. On this basis, it has been stated that a few educated people are teachers.

syllogism: Rien de ce qui est un robot n'est un être organique. Chaque personne qui est un humain est un être organique. Il s'ensuit qu'il existe un certain nombre d'humains qui ne sont pas des robots.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a robot is an organic being. Every single person who is a human is an organic being. It follows from this that there are a number of humans who are not robots.

syllogism: Tudo o que é um humano é um mamífero. Tudo o que é um macaco é um mamífero. Nenhum macaco é um mamífero.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a human is a mammal. Everything that is an ape is a mammal. No apes are mammals.

syllogism: Tout objet qui est une étendue d'eau est un gaz. Rien de ce qui est un océan n'est un gaz. Il existe au moins une étendue d'eau qui n'est pas un océan.
syllogism_orig: Any object that is a body of water is a gas. Nothing that is an ocean is a gas. There exists at least one body of water which is not an ocean.

syllogism: Hakuna mboga zinazoweza kuelezwa kuwa matunda. Karoti, katika kila hali, ni mboga. Kwa hivyo, ni hakika kwamba hakuna karoti ambazo ni matunda.
syllogism_orig: There are no vegetables that can be described as fruits. Carrots are, in every instance, vegetables. Therefore, it is certain that no carrots are fruits.

syllogism: Kila mtu ambaye ni mwanasiasa ni mwenye kufa. Wote wenye kufa ni binadamu. Kwa hivyo, kila binadamu ni mwanasiasa.
syllogism_orig: Every person who is a politician is a mortal. All mortals are humans. Consequently, every single human is a politician.

syllogism: Es gibt keine Bäume, die Lebewesen sind. Jeder einzelne Gegenstand, der eine Pflanze ist, ist ein Lebewesen. Daraus folgt, dass alle Pflanzen Bäume sind.
syllogism_orig: There are no trees that are living organisms. Every single item which is a plant is a living organism. This implies that all plants are trees.

syllogism: যেকোনো কিছু যা ওক তা উদ্ভিদ। এমন ওক আছে যা গাছ। এটি অবশ্যই অনুসরণ করে যে প্রতিটি গাছই উদ্ভিদ।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is an oak is a plant. There are oaks that are trees. It must follow that every single tree is a plant.

syllogism: Nenhuma árvore é um animal. Toda árvore é uma planta. Algumas plantas não são animais.
syllogism_orig: There are no trees that are also animals. Every single tree is a plant. It is the case that some plants fail to be animals.

syllogism: 恒星的集合与围绕其他天体运行的天体的集合互不相交。没有行星是围绕其他天体运行的天体。所有行星都是恒星。
syllogism_orig: The set of stars and the set of celestial bodies that orbit other celestial bodies are mutually exclusive. Nothing that is a planet is a celestial body that orbits another celestial body. The entire group of planets consists of stars.

syllogism: Alles, was eine Frucht ist, ist kein Backwerk. Alle Dinge, die Äpfel sind, sind Früchte. Folglich sind einige Dinge, die Äpfel sind, keine Backwaren.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a fruit is not a baked good. All of the things that are apples are fruits. Thus, some of the things that are apples are not baked goods.

syllogism: Toda cocina es una habitación. Toda cocina es un lugar para cocinar. Esto implica que algunos lugares para cocinar son habitaciones.
syllogism_orig: Each and every kitchen is a room. Each and every kitchen is a place for cooking. This implies that some places for cooking are rooms.

syllogism: Todos os peixes são aves. É verdade que nenhuma ave é aquática. Segue-se que nenhuma coisa aquática é um peixe.
syllogism_orig: All fish are birds. It is true that no bird is aquatic. It follows that no aquatic thing is a fish.

syllogism: Alles wat een hond is heeft vacht. Er zijn enkele poedels die honden zijn. Er zijn geen poedels die geen vacht hebben.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a dog has fur. There are some poodles that are dogs. There are no poodles that do not have fur.

syllogism: Il gruppo degli umani e il gruppo delle persone non hanno nulla in comune. Tutte le cose che sono uomini sono persone. Gli uomini non sono umani.
syllogism_orig: The group of humans and the group of people have nothing in common. All of the things that are men are people. Men are not humans.

syllogism: Alle Dinge, die Rotkehlchen sind, sind Vögel. Es gibt keinerlei Vögel, die Fische sind. Daraus folgt logisch, dass keine Fische Rotkehlchen sind.
syllogism_orig: All of the things that are robins are birds. There are no birds whatsoever that are fish. It logically follows that no fish are robins.

syllogism: È un fatto che ogni singolo cane è un mammifero. Allo stesso modo, è vero che tutti i barboncini sono mammiferi. Pertanto, è stato asserito che ogni barboncino è un cane.
syllogism_orig: It is a fact that every single dog is a mammal. Likewise, it is true that all poodles are mammals. Therefore, it has been asserted that every poodle is a dog.

syllogism: যে প্রাণী কুকুর সে কখনো স্তন্যপায়ী নয়। কুকুর যে প্রাণীগুলির মধ্যে একটি দল হলো রিট্রিভার। এ থেকে অনুমান করা যায় যে কিছু রিট্রিভার স্তন্যপায়ী নয়।
syllogism_orig: A creature that is a dog is never a mammal. Among the creatures that are dogs, a group are retrievers. One can infer from this that some retrievers are not mammals.

syllogism: Hay personas que son estudiantes. Algunos niños son estudiantes. Se sigue, entonces, que algunos niños son personas.
syllogism_orig: There are people who are students. A few children are students. It follows, then, that some children are people.

syllogism: Ningún coche es un barco. Algunos vehículos no son coches. Por lo tanto, todos los vehículos son barcos.
syllogism_orig: No car is a boat. Some vehicles are not cars. Therefore, all vehicles are boats.

syllogism: 没有汽车是船。没有渡轮是汽车。因此，有些渡轮是船。
syllogism_orig: There are no cars that are boats. There is not a single ferry that is a car. Consequently, some ferries are boats.

syllogism: Toda verdura es una planta. Todo lo que es una zanahoria es una verdura. Por lo tanto, todas las zanahorias son plantas.
syllogism_orig: Every single vegetable is a plant. Anything that is a carrot is a vegetable. Therefore, all carrots are plants.

syllogism: Kuna tufaha baadhi ambayo ni matunda. Kitu chochote ambacho ni tufaha kinaliwa. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya vitu vinavyoliwa ni matunda.
syllogism_orig: There exist some apples that are fruits. Anything that is an apple is edible. Thus, some edible things are fruits.

syllogism: Chaque créature qui est un chien est aussi un mammifère. Il existe certains jack russells qui sont des chiens. Il s'ensuit nécessairement que certains jack russells sont des mammifères.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature that is a dog is also a mammal. There are some jack russels which are dogs. It necessarily follows that some jack russels are mammals.

syllogism: Chaque chien est un animal. Aucun zèbre n'est un canidé. Il est le cas que quelque zèbre est un animal.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is an animal. There are no zebras which are canines. It is the case that some zebra is an animal.

syllogism: క్షీరదాలు అయిన గరుడ పక్షులు ఏవీ లేవు. ప్రతి ఒక్క గరుడ పక్షి ఒక పక్షి. దీని వల్ల కొన్ని పక్షులు క్షీరదాలు కావు అని తెలుస్తుంది.
syllogism_orig: There are no eagles that are mammals. Every single eagle is a bird. It is implied that some birds are not mammals.

syllogism: 每种昆虫都是动物。所有爬行动物都是动物。因此，每一种爬行动物都是蚂蚁。
syllogism_orig: Every insect is an animal. All reptiles are animals. Consequently, every single reptile is an ant.

syllogism: Kitu chochote ambacho ni kimiminika ni majimaji. Kila gesi ni majimaji. Hii inamaanisha kwamba gesi zote ni vimiminika.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a liquid is a fluid. Every single gas is a fluid. This means that all gases are liquids.

syllogism: Chaque humain est un être qui a des yeux. Il est vrai qu'aucun chien n'est un humain. Au moins certains chiens ont des yeux.
syllogism_orig: Every human is a being that has eyes. It is the case that no dog is a human. At least some dogs have eyes.

syllogism: Honden zijn op geen enkele manier zoogdieren. Alles wat een hond is, is een hondachtige. Er zijn enkele hondachtigen die geen zoogdieren zijn.
syllogism_orig: Dogs are in no way mammals. Anything that is a dog is a canine. There are some canines that are not mammals.

syllogism: Mashine zote ni binadamu. Kuna angalau wanafunzi wachache ambao si binadamu. Angalau mwanafunzi mmoja ni mashine.
syllogism_orig: All machines are humans. There are at least a few students who are not humans. At least one student is a machine.

syllogism: প্রতিটি মাছ একটি প্রাণী। প্রতিটি পাখি একটি প্রাণী। সকল পাখি মাছ।
syllogism_orig: Every single fish is a creature. Every bird is a creature. All birds are fish.

syllogism: Ни одна птица не является насекомым. Ни одна муха не является птицей. Следовательно, некоторые мухи являются насекомыми.
syllogism_orig: There are no birds which are insects. There is no fly that is a bird. It follows, then, that some flies are insects.

syllogism: Nessun elemento che può essere descritto come un gatto è un cane. Esistono animali domestici che sono cani. Dobbiamo concludere che alcuni animali domestici non sono gatti.
syllogism_orig: No item that can be described as a cat is a dog. There exist pets that are dogs. We must conclude that some pets are not cats.

syllogism: Hakuna mbwa ambaye pia ni mmea. Hakuna binadamu ambao ni mimea. Kundi la binadamu na kundi la mbwa haviingiliani.
syllogism_orig: There exists no dog that is also a plant. There are no humans who are plants. The group of humans and the group of dogs are mutually exclusive.

syllogism: Esiste una persona che è sia un politico che un avvocato. Il gruppo dei senatori include persone che sono avvocati. La conseguenza è che alcuni senatori sono politici.
syllogism_orig: There is a person who is both a politician and a lawyer. The group of senators includes people who are lawyers. The consequence is that some senators are politicians.

syllogism: Alles wat een bloem is, is gemaakt van metaal. Elke roos is een bloem. Ten minste één roos is gemaakt van metaal.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a flower is made of metal. Every single rose is a flower. At least one rose is made of metal.

syllogism: Каждый грузовик является транспортным средством. Некоторые пикапы являются транспортными средствами. Следовательно, некоторые пикапы не являются грузовиками.
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a truck is a vehicle. It is the case that a number of pickups are vehicles. Consequently, some pickups are not trucks.

syllogism: చేపలు మరియు వెచ్చని రక్తం కలిగిన జంతువులు ఏవీ లేవు. క్షీరదాల మొత్తం సమూహం వెచ్చని రక్తం కలిగిన జంతువులతో కూడి ఉంటుంది. చేపలు మరియు క్షీరదాలు పరస్పరం ప్రత్యేకమైన వర్గాలు.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are both fish and warm-blooded. The entire group of mammals consists of animals that are warm-blooded. Fish and mammals are mutually exclusive categories.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క సరీసృపం ఒక జీవి. జంతువుల సమూహంలో జీవులు ఏవీ లేవు. ఏ ఒక్క సరీసృపం కూడా జంతువు కాదు.
syllogism_orig: Every single reptile is a living thing. The set of animals contains no living things. Not a single reptile is an animal.

syllogism: Tudo que é um peixe pode voar. Também é o caso que todo pássaro pode voar. A partir disso, pode-se concluir que todos os peixes são pássaros.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a fish can fly. It is also the case that every single bird can fly. From this, it can be concluded that all fish are birds.

syllogism: 有些甜的食物是蛋糕。没有蛋糕是咸的食物。没有咸的食物是甜的食物。
syllogism_orig: There are some sweet foods that are cakes. There are no cakes that are salty foods. It is the case that no salty foods are sweet foods.

syllogism: Hakuna kitu chochote ambacho ni mashine ambacho ni mnyama. Inajulikana kwamba baadhi ya magari ni mashine. Kwa hivyo, ni lazima iwe kweli kwamba baadhi ya magari ni wanyama.
syllogism_orig: Not a single thing that is a machine is an animal. It is known that a portion of cars are machines. Thus, it must be true that some cars are animals.

syllogism: 凡是牧师都是男人。每一位教皇都是男人。由此必然得出结论：每一位教皇都是牧师。
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a priest is a man. Every single pope is a man. It is necessarily concluded that every pope is a priest.

syllogism: Ninguna máquina es una silla. Algunas sillas son cosas hechas de madera. Por lo tanto, algunas cosas hechas de madera no son máquinas.
syllogism_orig: There is no machine that is a chair. A few chairs happen to be things that are made of wood. Therefore, some things made of wood are not machines.

syllogism: Ogni singola casa è una cosa che è un edificio. Un capanno non è mai una cosa che è un edificio. Ne consegue che nessun capanno è una casa.
syllogism_orig: Every single house is a thing that is a building. A shed is never a thing that is a building. It follows that no shed is a house.

syllogism: Nessun pappagallo è un mammifero. Alcuni uccelli sono pappagalli. Ciò implica che nessun uccello è un mammifero.
syllogism_orig: There are no parrots which are mammals. Some birds are parrots. This implies that no birds are mammals.

syllogism: Cada pájaro tiene la capacidad de leer novelas. Existen algunas palomas que son pájaros. Por lo tanto, algunas palomas pueden leer novelas.
syllogism_orig: Every single bird has the ability to read novels. There exist some pigeons which are birds. Therefore, some pigeons can read novels.

syllogism: Nenhum animal terrestre é um animal aquático. Um certo número de hipopótamos encontra-se entre os animais terrestres. Assim, pode-se concluir que alguns hipopótamos são animais aquáticos.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a land animal is an aquatic animal. A certain number of hippos are to be found among the land animals. Thus, it can be concluded that some hippos are aquatic animals.

syllogism: Es gibt keine Fahrzeuge, die aus Metall bestehen. Jedes einzelne Auto ist ein Fahrzeug. Das bedeutet, dass kein Auto aus Metall besteht.
syllogism_orig: There are no vehicles that are made of metal. Every single car is a vehicle. This means that no car is made of metal.

syllogism: কিছু লেখক কবিও বটে। এটি জানা যায় যে কিছু ঔপন্যাসিক লেখক। এটি বলা হয়েছে যে কিছু ঔপন্যাসিক কবি।
syllogism_orig: Some writers are also poets. It is known that some novelists are writers. It has been said that some novelists are poets.

syllogism: Kila kiumbe ambacho ni samaki kinaishi katika miti. Chochote ambacho ni samoni ni aina ya samaki. Kwa lazima inahitimishwa kwamba samoni wote wanaishi katika miti.
syllogism_orig: Every single organism that is a fish lives in trees. Anything that is a salmon is a type of fish. It is necessarily concluded that all salmon live in trees.

syllogism: Tutti quanti gli esseri umani sono mortali. È un fatto noto che tutti gli esseri umani sono primati. Pertanto, ogni singolo primate è mortale.
syllogism_orig: Any and all humans are mortal. It is a known fact that all humans are primates. Thus, every single primate is mortal.

syllogism: যেকোনো কিছু যা চড়ুই তা পাখিও। কিছু বাদুড় আছে যারা পাখি নয়। এর অর্থ অবশ্যই এই যে কিছু বাদুড় চড়ুই নয়।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a sparrow is also a bird. There are some bats which are not birds. This necessarily means that some bats are not sparrows.

syllogism: Ci sono alcuni animali che non sono mammiferi. Tutto ciò che è un cane è un mammifero. Quindi, ogni cane è un animale.
syllogism_orig: There are some animals that are not mammals. Everything that is a dog is a mammal. Thus, every dog is an animal.

syllogism: Alles, was ein Dichter ist, ist auch ein Schriftsteller. Alle Schriftsteller sind Menschen, die kreativ sind. Daraus können wir schließen, dass ein Teil der kreativen Menschen Dichter sind.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a poet is also a writer. All writers are people who are creative. We can conclude from this that a portion of creative people are poets.

syllogism: Todo lo que es un mamífero es una criatura de sangre caliente. Algunos animales son, sin lugar a dudas, mamíferos. Por lo tanto, cada uno de los animales está hecho de madera.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a mammal is a creature that is warm-blooded. Some animals are, without a doubt, mammals. Therefore, every single animal is made of wood.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క రాయి ఒక మేఘము. మేఘము అయిన ప్రతిది ఒక జంతువు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని జంతువులు రాళ్ళు.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that every single stone is a cloud. Anything that is a cloud is an animal. Therefore, a few animals are stones.

syllogism: Nichts, was eine Emotion ist, ist ein Gefühl. Gewisse Emotionen werden als Traurigkeit klassifiziert. Es muss der Fall sein, dass manche Traurigkeit kein Gefühl ist.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is an emotion is a feeling. Certain emotions are classified as sadness. It must be the case that some sadness is not a feeling.

syllogism: Nessun liquido è un fluido. Tutta l'acqua è un liquido. Di conseguenza, qualche acqua non è un fluido.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no liquid is a fluid. All water is a liquid. Consequently, some of the water is not a fluid.

syllogism: Ninguna pintura es una obra de literatura. Toda novela es una obra de literatura. La implicación es que existen algunas novelas que no son pinturas.
syllogism_orig: There are no paintings that are also works of literature. Every single novel is a work of literature. The implication is that there exist some novels which are not paintings.

syllogism: Es gibt Gemüse, das wächst. Jedes einzelne Gemüse ist eine Pflanze. Daraus folgt, dass keine einzige Pflanze ein Gemüse ist.
syllogism_orig: There exist vegetables that grow. Every single vegetable is a plant. It follows that not a single plant is a vegetable.

syllogism: Tudo que é um quadrado é um quadrilátero. Não existem formas que são triângulos que também possam ser descritas como quadriláteros. Existem certos triângulos que não são quadrados.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a square is a quadrilateral. There are no shapes that are triangles which can also be described as quadrilaterals. There exist certain triangles that are not squares.

syllogism: El grupo de profesionales es un subconjunto del grupo de personas. Todo lo que es doctor es profesional. Por lo tanto, hay algunas personas que no son doctores.
syllogism_orig: The group of professionals is a subset of the group of people. Everything that is a doctor is a professional. Therefore, there are some people who are not doctors.

syllogism: Kitu chochote ambacho ni gari ni chombo cha usafiri. Kila sedani ni chombo cha usafiri. Hii inamaanisha kwamba sedani zote ni magari.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a car is a vehicle. Every single sedan is a vehicle. This means that all sedans are cars.

syllogism: È vero che alcune cose che sono alberi non sono querce. Tutto ciò che è un albero è una pianta. Ne consegue che ci sono alcune piante che non sono querce.
syllogism_orig: It is true that some things that are trees are not oaks. Everything that is a tree is a plant. It follows that there are some plants that are not oaks.

syllogism: Er zijn enkele voertuigen die machines zijn. Elke auto is een voertuig. Daarom is het het geval dat elke auto een machine is.
syllogism_orig: There are some vehicles that are machines. Every single car is a vehicle. It is therefore the case that every car is a machine.

syllogism: ద్రవంగా ఉన్న ఏదైనా ఘనపదార్థం కాదు. ద్రవంగా ఉన్న నీరు ఏదీ లేదు. కాబట్టి, ప్రతి నీటి బొట్టు ఘనపదార్థం.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a liquid is not a solid. There is no water that is a liquid. Consequently, every drop of water is a solid.

syllogism: 并非所有花是植物。所有玫瑰是花。因此，有些玫瑰不是植物。
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any flower is a plant. All things that are roses are flowers. Thus, some roses are not plants.

syllogism: Ci sono alcune creature mitiche che sono centauri. Ogni singolo centauro è un animale domestico. Di conseguenza, è il caso che alcuni animali domestici siano creature mitiche.
syllogism_orig: There are some creatures that are mythical that are centaurs. Every single one of the centaurs is a domesticated animal. Consequently, it is the case that some domesticated animals are mythical creatures.

syllogism: Hakuna mboga ambazo ni tufaha. Miongoni mwa tufaha, chache ni matunda mekundu. Si matunda mekundu yote ni mboga.
syllogism_orig: There are no vegetables that are apples. Among the apples, a few are red fruits. Not all red fruits are vegetables.

syllogism: Il n'existe rien qui soit un canin qui soit aussi un félin. Tout animal qui est un chien est, de par sa nature même, un canin. On peut logiquement conclure qu'aucun chien n'est un félin.
syllogism_orig: There is nothing that is a canine which is also a feline. Every animal that is a dog is, by its very nature, a canine. It can be logically concluded that no dogs are felines.

syllogism: প্রতিটি মানুষ মাছ নয়। কিছু মাছ আছে যারা জলে বাস করা প্রাণীও বটে। এটি সত্য যে সব জলে বাস করা প্রাণী মানুষ নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every single human is not a fish. There are a few fish that are also creatures that live in water. It is the case that not all creatures that live in water are humans.

syllogism: কোনো প্রাণী পাথর নয়। এটাও সত্য যে কোনো বিড়াল পাথর নয়। অতএব, যুক্তি দেওয়া হয় যে কোনো বিড়াল প্রাণী নয়।
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are rocks. It is also true that no cats are rocks. Therefore, it is argued that there are no cats which are animals.

syllogism: 所有演员都是表演者。有些男人是演员。因此，我们可以推出有些男人是表演者。
syllogism_orig: It is the case that all actors are performers. There are some men who are actors. Therefore, we can derive that some men are performers.

syllogism: Ci sono alcuni cani che sono gatti. Non ci sono gatti che sono rettili. Di conseguenza, alcuni rettili sono cani.
syllogism_orig: There are some dogs that are cats. There are no cats that are reptiles. As a result, some reptiles are dogs.

syllogism: 每一个国家都有一个首都。被称为法国的实体是一个国家。法国至少有某一部分拥有一个首都。
syllogism_orig: Every single country has a capital city. The entity known as France is a country. There is at least some part of France that has a capital city.

syllogism: Группа существ, имеющих восемь ног, не пересекается с группой паукообразных. Все паукообразные являются пауками. Из этого следует, что часть пауков не является существами, имеющими восемь ног.
syllogism_orig: The group of creatures that have eight legs does not intersect with the group of arachnids. All of the arachnids are spiders. It must be the case that a portion of spiders are not creatures that have eight legs.

syllogism: Nessun uccello è un rettile. Una parte della popolazione dei pinguini sono uccelli. Pertanto, alcuni pinguini sono esclusi dal gruppo dei rettili.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no bird is a reptile. A portion of the penguin population are birds. Thus, some penguins are excluded from the group of reptiles.

syllogism: Cada líquido es mojado. Se sabe que ninguna arena es un líquido. En consecuencia, no hay cosas hechas de arena que sean mojadas.
syllogism_orig: Every single liquid is wet. It is known that no sand is a liquid. Consequently, there are no things made of sand which are wet.

syllogism: No hay plantas que puedan llamarse árboles. También es cierto que toda planta es un tipo de vegetal. Esto ha llevado a la conclusión de que todo vegetal es un árbol.
syllogism_orig: There are no plants that can be called trees. It is also true that every plant is a type of vegetable. This has led to the conclusion that every vegetable is a tree.

syllogism: టేబుల్ అయిన ఏదైనా చెట్టు కాదు. టేబుల్‌లు ఉన్నాయి, మరియు వాటిలో కొన్ని ఫర్నీచర్‌గా గుర్తించబడతాయి. దీని ఆధారంగా, ఫర్నీచర్ వస్తువులలో కొంత భాగం చెట్లు కాకూడదు.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a table is not a tree. There are tables, and some of them can be identified as furniture. Based on this, a portion of furniture pieces must not be trees.

syllogism: Каждое млекопитающее является животным. Каждая рыба является животным. Это позволяет предположить, что некоторые рыбы являются млекопитающими.
syllogism_orig: Every mammal is an animal. Every fish is an animal. This suggests that some fish are mammals.

syllogism: Toda árvore é uma coisa que está viva. Qualquer coisa que é uma planta está viva. Pelo menos uma planta é uma árvore.
syllogism_orig: Every single tree is a thing that is alive. Anything that is a plant is alive. At least one plant is a tree.

syllogism: Ни один квадрат не является кругом. Некоторые фигуры являются квадратами. Следовательно, некоторые фигуры являются кругами.
syllogism_orig: There is no square that is a circle. Some of the shapes are squares. Therefore, it is the case that some shapes are circles.

syllogism: Верно, что каждая ручка является объектом. Некоторые вещи не являются ручками. Из этого можно утверждать, что некоторые вещи не являются объектами.
syllogism_orig: It is true that every pen is an object. Some things are not pens. From this, it can be claimed that some things are not objects.

syllogism: 能呼吸氧气的生物与岩石之间没有重叠。所有岩石都是动物。某些动物不是能呼吸氧气的生物。
syllogism_orig: There is no overlap between living things that can breathe oxygen and rocks. All things that are rocks are animals. Certain animals are not living things that can breathe oxygen.

syllogism: Es ist der Fall, dass kein Säugetier ein Tier ist. Es gibt einige Hunde, die Tiere sind. Es muss der Fall sein, dass einige Hunde keine Säugetiere sind.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no mammal is an animal. There are some dogs that are animals. It must be the case that some dogs are not mammals.

syllogism: ప్రతి త్రిభుజం ఒక ఆకారం. ఏ వృత్తం త్రిభుజం కాదు. కాబట్టి, ఏ వృత్తం ఆకారం కాలేదు.
syllogism_orig: Every triangle is a shape. No circle is a triangle. Therefore, no circle can be a shape.

syllogism: ప్రతి పిల్లి ఒక క్షీరదం. డాల్ఫిన్‌ల సమూహంలో పిల్లులు లేవు. ప్రతి ఒక్క డాల్ఫిన్ ఒక క్షీరదం.
syllogism_orig: Every cat is a mammal. The set of dolphins contains no cats. Every single dolphin is a mammal.

syllogism: ప్రతి పిల్లి ఒక జంతువు. కొన్ని కుక్కలు జంతువులు. దీని నుండి ప్రతి ఒక్క కుక్క ఒక పిల్లి అని తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: Every cat is an animal. There are a number of dogs that are animals. It follows from this that every single dog is a cat.

syllogism: Cada coche es un tipo de vehículo con motor. Existen algunas bicicletas que no tienen motor. Es el caso que algunas bicicletas no son coches.
syllogism_orig: Every single car is a type of vehicle with an engine. There exist some bicycles that do not have an engine. It is the case that some bicycles are not cars.

syllogism: Es ist eine Tatsache, dass alle Katzen Felinen sind. Alles, was eine Feline ist, ist ein Säugetier. Daraus folgt, dass jedes einzelne Säugetier eine Katze ist.
syllogism_orig: It is a fact that all cats are felines. Everything that is a feline is a mammal. Therefore, every single mammal is a cat.

syllogism: Любое существо, которое является птицей, является животным. Часть животных содержится в качестве домашних питомцев. Некоторые домашние питомцы не являются птицами.
syllogism_orig: Any creature that is a bird is an animal. A portion of animals are kept as pets. Some pets are not birds.

syllogism: Toda fruta é um objeto que contém sementes. Sem exceção, todas as maçãs são frutas. Pode-se concluir que toda maçã contém sementes.
syllogism_orig: Every fruit is an object that contains seeds. Without exception, all apples are fruits. It can be concluded that every apple contains seeds.

syllogism: Ninguna luna es un planeta. Todo lo que es un planeta es también un cuerpo celeste. Algunos cuerpos celestes no son lunas.
syllogism_orig: There are no moons that are also planets. Everything that is a planet is also a celestial body. Some celestial bodies are not moons.

syllogism: Nessun libro di narrativa è una biografia. Alcuni romanzi rientrano nella categoria dei libri di narrativa. Questo ci permette di affermare che alcuni romanzi non sono biografie.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a fiction book is a biography. Some novels fall under the category of fiction books. This allows us to state that some novels are not biographies.

syllogism: Le montagne non possono essere oceani. Ogni montagna chiamata Everest è una montagna. Deve essere che alcune montagne chiamate Everest non sono oceani.
syllogism_orig: Mountains cannot be oceans. Every mountain named Everest is a mountain. It must be that some mountains named Everest are not oceans.

syllogism: Non esistono macchine che siano anche umani. Qualsiasi cosa possa essere chiamata studente è, senza eccezione, un umano. Nessuno studente è una macchina.
syllogism_orig: There exist no machines that are also humans. Anything that can be called a student is, without exception, a human. No students are machines.

syllogism: Hakuna jiwe hata moja ambalo ni mnyama. Kila kitu ambacho ni mbwa ni jiwe. Hii inamaanisha kwamba baadhi ya mbwa ni wanyama.
syllogism_orig: Not a single rock is an animal. Every single item which is a dog is a rock. This implies that some dogs are animals.

syllogism: 凡是三角形都不是有三条边的形状。凡是等边三角形都是三角形。因此，有些等边三角形不是有三条边的形状。
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a triangle is not a shape with three sides. Every single thing that is an equilateral triangle is a triangle. Therefore, it is the case that some equilateral triangles are not shapes with three sides.

syllogism: Il est vrai qu'aucun ordinateur n'est un ordinateur portable. Il est également vrai qu'aucune table n'est un ordinateur. De ces énoncés, on peut conclure que certaines tables sont des ordinateurs portables.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no computers are laptops. It is also true that no tables are computers. From these statements, it can be concluded that some tables are laptops.

syllogism: Каждая звезда является планетой. Ни одна планета не является солнцем. Следовательно, это обоснованный вывод, что некоторые солнца не являются звёздами.
syllogism_orig: Every single star is a planet. No planets are suns. It is therefore a sound deduction that some suns are not stars.
