syllogism: Tout ce qui est un humain est un mortel. Toutes les choses qui sont des arbres sont des mortels. Cela signifie que tout ce qui est un arbre est un humain.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a human is a mortal. All things that are trees are mortals. This means that everything that is a tree is a human.

syllogism: Een smartphone is een werktuig. Alles wat een werktuig is, is een robot. Daarom is elke robot een smartphone.
syllogism_orig: A smartphone is a tool. Everything that is a tool is a robot. This is why every robot is a smartphone.

syllogism: 有些行星是玫瑰。所有玫瑰实际上都是花。由此可得，有些花是行星。
syllogism_orig: There are some planets which are roses. All roses are, in fact, flowers. It follows that some flowers are planets.

syllogism: Niente che sia un veicolo è in grado di volare. Ogni aeroplano è un veicolo. È dunque un fatto che nessun aeroplano è in grado di volare.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a vehicle is able to fly. Each and every airplane is a vehicle. It is therefore a fact that no airplane is able to fly.

syllogism: Ninguna de las cosas que son gatos es un animal acuático. Todos los tigres son cosas que son gatos. Se sigue lógicamente que algunos tigres no son animales acuáticos.
syllogism_orig: None of the things that are cats are aquatic animals. All tigers are things that are cats. It follows logically that some tigers are not aquatic animals.

syllogism: 每一个是狗的东西都是哺乳动物。任何是猫的东西都是哺乳动物。由此可以说，有些猫是狗。
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a dog is a mammal. Anything that is a cat is a mammal. From this, it can be stated that some cats are dogs.

syllogism: Kuna watu fulani ambao ni wasanii ambao si wachoraji. Kila mtu ambaye ni msanii ni mtu mbunifu. Kwa hivyo, watu fulani wabunifu ni wachoraji.
syllogism_orig: There exist some individuals who are artists that are not painters. Every single person who is an artist is a creative person. It follows that some creative people are painters.

syllogism: No es cierto que algún mamífero sea un pez. Hay unos pocos peces que también son humanos. Hay algunos humanos que no son mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any mammal is a fish. There are a few fish that are also humans. There are some humans that are not mammals.

syllogism: Alles, was ein lebender Organismus ist, ist etwas, das Energie verbraucht. Alle Pflanzen sind Dinge, die Energie verbrauchen. Das bedeutet, dass alle Pflanzen lebende Organismen sind.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a living organism is a thing that consumes energy. Any and all plants are things that consume energy. This means that all plants are living organisms.

syllogism: కొంతమంది యూరోపియన్లు ప్రజలు అనేది నిజం. జర్మన్లు అయిన వాటిలో, కొందరు ప్రజలు. ఏకైక నిర్ణయం ఏమిటంటే కొంతమంది జర్మన్లు యూరోపియన్లు కారు.
syllogism_orig: It is true that some Europeans are people. Among the items that are Germans, some are people. The only conclusion is that some Germans are not Europeans.

syllogism: Kila kitu ambacho ni wingu pia ni reptilia. Kila kitu ambacho ni wingu pia ni samaki. Kwa hivyo, baadhi ya samaki ni reptilia.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a cloud is also a reptile. Everything that is a cloud is also a fish. Hence, some fish are reptiles.

syllogism: Jeder Gegenstand, der ein Baum ist, ist eine Pflanze. Es ist der Fall, dass ein Teil der Kiefern Pflanzen sind. Daraus folgt, dass nicht alle Kiefern Bäume sind.
syllogism_orig: Any item that is a tree is a plant. It is the case that a portion of pines are plants. Therefore, not all pines are trees.

syllogism: Nada que sea una fruta es brócoli. Todos los brócolis son vegetales. Un subconjunto de los vegetales no es fruta.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a fruit is broccoli. All items of broccoli are vegetables. A subset of vegetables is not fruit.

syllogism: Ci sono alcuni edifici che non sono grattacieli. Tutti gli edifici sono considerati strutture. È quindi vero che alcune strutture non sono grattacieli.
syllogism_orig: There are some buildings that are not skyscrapers. All buildings are considered structures. It is therefore true that some structures are not skyscrapers.

syllogism: Pas un seul livre de non-fiction n'est une œuvre de fiction. Tous les romans sont des œuvres de fiction. Il s'ensuit que quelques romans ne sont pas des livres de non-fiction.
syllogism_orig: Not one single nonfiction book is a fictional work. All novels are fictional works. It follows from this that some novels are not nonfiction books.

syllogism: Некоторые рестораны быстрого питания имеют окно для обслуживания автомобилистов. Существуют кофейни, которые также являются ресторанами быстрого питания. Из этого следует, что некоторые кофейни имеют окно для обслуживания автомобилистов.
syllogism_orig: Some fast food restaurants have a drive-thru. There are coffee shops which are also fast food restaurants. It follows, then, that some coffee shops have a drive-thru.

syllogism: 每一种蔬菜都是一颗行星。任何行星都是一种乐器。由此必然得出，有些乐器是蔬菜。
syllogism_orig: Every single vegetable is a planet. Anything that is a planet is a musical instrument. It is a logical necessity that some musical instruments are vegetables.

syllogism: 每一种哺乳动物都是动物。没有任何一条狗是动物。因此，没有任何一条狗是哺乳动物。
syllogism_orig: Every mammal is a thing that is an animal. There is not a single dog that is an animal. Consequently, no dog is a mammal.

syllogism: La categoria delle lune e la categoria dei corpi celesti non si sovrappongono. Tutti i corpi celesti sono pianeti. Un sottoinsieme dei pianeti sono lune.
syllogism_orig: The category of moons and the category of celestial bodies do not overlap. All celestial bodies are planets. A subset of planets are moons.

syllogism: Ни один камень не может быть классифицирован как растение. Некоторый гранит входит в категорию камней. Следовательно, некоторый гранит не является растением.
syllogism_orig: There are no rocks that can be classified as plants. Some granite is included in the category of rocks. Consequently, it follows that some granite is not plants.

syllogism: Jedes einzelne Geschöpf, das ein Schwein ist, ist flugfähig. Es gibt einige Nutztiere, die Schweine sind. Folglich kann ein Teil der Nutztiere fliegen.
syllogism_orig: Every single creature that is a pig is capable of flight. There are some farm animals which are pigs. Therefore, a portion of farm animals can fly.

syllogism: Aucun liquide n'est un chat. Quelques chiens sont des liquides. On en conclut que quelques chiens sont des chats.
syllogism_orig: No liquids are cats. Some dogs are liquids. It is concluded that some dogs are cats.

syllogism: Ни одна кошка не является домашним животным. Всё, что является кошкой, является млекопитающим. Следовательно, все домашние животные являются млекопитающими.
syllogism_orig: Not one cat is a pet. Everything that is a cat is a mammal. It follows that all pets are mammals.

syllogism: Die Menge der Künstler enthält keine Personen, die systematische Forschung betreiben. Jeder einzelne Wissenschaftler ist eine Person, die systematische Forschung betreibt. Künstler sind keine Wissenschaftler.
syllogism_orig: The set of artists contains no people who conduct systematic research. Every single scientist is a person who conducts systematic research. Artists are not scientists.

syllogism: Все собаки являются млекопитающими. Ни одна кошка не является собакой. Следовательно, ни одна кошка не является млекопитающим.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that all dogs are mammals. No cats are dogs. It follows that no cat is a mammal.

syllogism: Er zijn geen vogels die vissen zijn. Het is het geval dat sommige papegaaien vogels zijn. We kunnen concluderen dat geen enkele papegaai een vis is.
syllogism_orig: There are no birds that are fish. It is the case that some parrots are birds. We can conclude that no parrots are fish.

syllogism: 昆虫类和八条腿的生物类不重叠。所有八条腿的生物都是蜘蛛。一部分昆虫是蜘蛛。
syllogism_orig: The class of insects and the class of creatures with eight legs do not overlap. All creatures with eight legs are spiders. A subset of insects are spiders.

syllogism: Elke wolk is een voertuig. Er zijn geen wolken die bussen zijn. Dus er is geen bus die een voertuig is.
syllogism_orig: Every single cloud is a vehicle. There are no clouds that are buses. Therefore, there is no bus that is a vehicle.

syllogism: Всё, что является романом, является книгой. Все книги являются публикациями. Из этих фактов ясно, что некоторые публикации являются романами.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a novel is a book. All books are publications. From these facts, it is clear that a few publications are novels.

syllogism: Hakuna reptilia ambao ni binadamu. Pia ni kweli kwamba hakuna mchwa ambaye ni reptilia. Kwa hivyo, hakuna mchwa ambaye ni binadamu.
syllogism_orig: There are no reptiles that are humans. It is also true that no ant is a reptile. It follows that no ant is a human.

syllogism: కొన్ని జంతువులు క్షీరదాలు. ఏ క్షీరదాలు పక్షులు కావు. దీని నుండి కొన్ని పక్షులు జంతువులు అని తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: There are some animals that are mammals. There are no mammals that are birds. It follows from this that some birds are animals.

syllogism: 液体绝不是物质。任何液体都是流体。有些流体不是物质。
syllogism_orig: Liquids are in no way substances. Anything that is a liquid is a fluid. It's the case that some fluids are not substances.

syllogism: Chaque morceau d'or est une substance précieuse. Aucun plastique n'est de l'or. Il s'ensuit qu'aucun plastique n'est une substance précieuse.
syllogism_orig: Every single piece of gold is a precious substance. No plastic is gold. It follows that no plastic is a precious substance.

syllogism: Ogni romanzo è un'opera di finzione. Nessuna opera di finzione è un articolo di cronaca. Ne consegue che nessun articolo di cronaca è un romanzo.
syllogism_orig: Every novel is a work of fiction. No work of fiction is a news article. It is thus the case that no news article is a novel.

syllogism: Het is waar dat alles wat een vogel is een gevleugeld wezen is. Er zijn geen insecten die vogels zijn. Een conclusie die hieruit getrokken kan worden is dat er geen insecten zijn die gevleugelde wezens zijn.
syllogism_orig: It is true that everything which is a bird is a winged creature. There are no insects which are birds. A conclusion that can be drawn from this is that there are no insects which are winged creatures.

syllogism: Tutto ciò che è un albero è uno strumento musicale. Ci sono alcune querce che non sono strumenti musicali. Questo porta alla conclusione che alcune querce non sono alberi.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a tree is a musical instrument. There are some oaks that are not musical instruments. This leads to the conclusion that some oaks are not trees.

syllogism: Alles, was ein Auto ist, hat einen Motor. Es ist der Fall, dass kein Fahrrad ein Auto ist. Kein Fahrrad hat einen Motor.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a car has an engine. It is the case that no bicycle is a car. No bicycle has an engine.

syllogism: এটা সত্য নয় যে কোনো পতঙ্গ আট পা বিশিষ্ট প্রাণী। প্রতিটি পতঙ্গ একটি মাকড়সা। এর থেকে অনুমিত হয় যে প্রতিটি মাকড়সা আট পা বিশিষ্ট প্রাণী।
syllogism_orig: It is not true that any insect is a creature with eight legs. Every insect is a spider. It follows that every spider is a creature with eight legs.

syllogism: Viatu vichache ni matunda. Kila tunda hukua kwenye mmea. Inaweza kuhitimishwa kwamba baadhi ya vitu vinavyokua kwenye mimea ni viatu.
syllogism_orig: A few shoes are fruits. Every single fruit grows on a plant. It can be deduced that some things that grow on plants are shoes.

syllogism: Absolut nichts, was ein Wassertier ist, ist eine Katzenart. Es ist der Fall, dass einige Katzen Wassertiere sind. Folglich sind nicht alle Katzen Katzenarten.
syllogism_orig: Absolutely nothing that is an aquatic animal is a feline. It is the case that some cats are aquatic animals. Thus, not all cats are felines.

syllogism: Nenhuma coisa que é um animal é uma planta. Tudo que é uma árvore é uma planta. Consequentemente, existem algumas árvores que não são animais.
syllogism_orig: There are no things which are animals that are plants. Everything that is a tree is a plant. Consequently, there exist some trees which are not animals.

syllogism: Kein einziger Arzt ist eine Person, die auf der Bühne auftritt. Jeder einzelne Musiker gilt als eine Person, die auf der Bühne auftritt. Folglich gibt es einige Musiker, die keine Ärzte sind.
syllogism_orig: Not one single doctor is a person who performs on stage. Every single musician is considered a person who performs on stage. Consequently, there exist some musicians who are not doctors.

syllogism: Väter sind in keiner Weise Menschen. Alles, was ein Vater ist, ist eine Mutter. Es gibt einige Mütter, die keine Menschen sind.
syllogism_orig: Fathers are in no way humans. Anything that is a father is a mother. There are some mothers that are not humans.

syllogism: যা কিছু গাড়ি তা একটি সচেতন মেঘ। সমস্ত সচেতন মেঘ উদ্ভিদ। এর অর্থ হলো কিছু উদ্ভিদ গাড়ি।
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a car is a sentient cloud. All sentient clouds are plants. This means that some plants are cars.

syllogism: 所有轿车都是汽车。每一辆轿车都是车辆。因此，所有车辆都一定是汽车。
syllogism_orig: All sedans are cars. Every sedan is a vehicle. Therefore, all vehicles must be cars.

syllogism: Hakuna viumbe vinavyoruka ambavyo ni ndege. Idadi fulani ya shomoro ni viumbe vinavyoruka. Kwa hivyo, si shomoro wote ni ndege.
syllogism_orig: There are no flying creatures which are birds. A certain number of sparrows are flying creatures. It follows that not all sparrows are birds.

syllogism: Hakuna samaki ambao ni viumbe wenye manyoya. Wanyama wote wanaochukuliwa kuwa mamalia ni viumbe wenye manyoya. Kwa hivyo, inaweza kusemwa kwamba baadhi ya mamalia si samaki.
syllogism_orig: No fish are creatures with fur. All of the animals that are considered mammals are creatures with fur. Consequently, it can be said that some mammals are not fish.

syllogism: Rien de ce qui est un véhicule n'est un mode de transport. Un certain nombre de voitures sont composées de véhicules. Il s'ensuit qu'une portion de voitures ne sont pas des modes de transport.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a vehicle is a mode of transportation. A certain number of cars are composed of vehicles. It follows that a portion of cars are not modes of transportation.

syllogism: Es ist der Fall, dass alle Möbel aus Holz sind. Alles, was ein Stuhl ist, ist auch aus Holz. Einige Stühle sind keine Möbel.
syllogism_orig: It's the case that all furniture is made of wood. Anything that is a chair is also made of wood. Some chairs fail to be furniture.

syllogism: Kila mbwa ni mamalia. Mamalia wote ni ndege. Kwa hivyo, kila ndege ni mbwa.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is a mammal. All mammals are birds. Consequently, every single bird is a dog.

syllogism: Todo lo que es una piedra es suave. Cada diamante es una piedra. Cierta cantidad de diamantes es suave.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a stone is soft. Every single diamond is a stone. A certain quantity of diamonds is soft.

syllogism: Aucun poisson n'est un mammifère. Aucun chien n'est un mammifère. On peut en déduire qu'aucun chien n'est un poisson.
syllogism_orig: There is no fish that is a mammal. There are no dogs that are mammals. It can be deduced that there are no dogs that are fish.

syllogism: Ningún polígono es una figura con tres lados. Todos los triángulos son figuras con tres lados. La implicación es que algunos triángulos no son polígonos.
syllogism_orig: There are no polygons that are shapes with three sides. All triangles are shapes with three sides. The implication is that some triangles are not polygons.

syllogism: প্রতিটি তরল একটি প্রবাহী। কিছু জলাশয় আছে যেগুলি তরল। জল কোনোভাবেই প্রবাহী নয়।
syllogism_orig: Every single liquid is a fluid. There are some water bodies which are liquid. Water is in no way a fluid.

syllogism: Hay algunos animales que son aves. Es un hecho que algunos animales no son peces. Debe ser el caso de que ningún pez es un ave.
syllogism_orig: There are some animals that are birds. It is a fact that some animals are not fish. It must be the case that no fish is a bird.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క కుక్క కిరణజన్య సంయోగక్రియ చేయగల సామర్థ్యం కలిగి ఉంటుంది. కొన్ని కుక్కలు పూడిల్‌లు. దీని అర్థం పూడిల్‌లలో కొంత భాగం కిరణజన్య సంయోగక్రియ చేయగలవు.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is capable of photosynthesis. There exist dogs which are poodles. This implies that a portion of poodles can photosynthesize.

syllogism: Nessuna camicia è un paio di pantaloni. Nessuna giacca è un paio di pantaloni. Quindi, possiamo concludere che alcune giacche sono camicie.
syllogism_orig: There are no shirts that are also pants. It is true that no jacket is a pair of pants. Therefore, we can conclude that a few jackets are shirts.

syllogism: Ни одно мифическое существо не является человеком. Некоторые мифические существа являются инопланетянами. Некоторые инопланетяне являются людьми.
syllogism_orig: There are no mythical creatures who are people. A few mythical creatures are aliens. It is the case that a portion of all aliens are people.

syllogism: Todo perro es un mamífero. Todos los gatos también son mamíferos. Por lo tanto, es necesario que algunos gatos no sean perros.
syllogism_orig: Every dog is a mammal. All cats are also mammals. Therefore, it must be that some cats are not dogs.

syllogism: যা কিছু জল তা H2O অণুও। এমন কোনো বরফ নেই যা H2O অণু। অতএব, বরফ জল হতে পারে না।
syllogism_orig: Anything that is water is also an H2O molecule. There is no ice that is an H2O molecule. Therefore, ice cannot be water.

syllogism: Ci sono alcune persone intelligenti che sono fisici. Ogni fisico è uno scienziato. Di conseguenza, ogni singolo scienziato è una persona intelligente.
syllogism_orig: There are some smart people that are physicists. Every physicist is a scientist. As a result, every single scientist is a smart person.

syllogism: প্রতিটি সবজি সবুজ। যেকোনো কিছু যা পাতা তা সবুজ। এটি অনিবার্যভাবে উপসংহারে আসা যায় যে প্রতিটি পাতা একটি সবজি।
syllogism_orig: Every single vegetable is green. Anything that is a leaf is green. It is necessarily concluded that every leaf is a vegetable.

syllogism: কোনো বস্তু আসবাবপত্র নয়। প্রতিটি টেবিল একটি বস্তু। এর থেকে অনুমিত হয় যে কোনো টেবিলই আসবাবপত্র হতে পারে না।
syllogism_orig: There are no objects that are furniture. Each and every table is an object. It follows that no table can be an item of furniture.

syllogism: Es gibt keine Tiere, die sowohl Fleischfresser als auch Pflanzenfresser sind. Eine gewisse Anzahl von Wölfen sind Fleischfresser. Daraus folgt, dass keine Wölfe Pflanzenfresser sind.
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are both carnivores and herbivores. A certain number of wolves are carnivores. It follows that no wolves are herbivores.

syllogism: প্রতিটি নার্স এমন কেউ যে উড়তে পারে। কিছু নার্স ডাক্তার। অতএব, একটি নির্দিষ্ট সংখ্যক ডাক্তার উড়তে পারে।
syllogism_orig: Every single nurse is someone who can fly. A few nurses are doctors. Therefore, a certain number of doctors can fly.

syllogism: Ninguna estrella es un planeta. Toda estrella es un cuerpo celeste. Por lo tanto, es verdad que todo cuerpo celeste es un planeta.
syllogism_orig: There are no stars that are planets. Each and every star is a celestial body. It is therefore true that every celestial body is a planet.

syllogism: Всё, что является планетой, тайно является роботом. Всё, что тайно является роботом, является живым существом. Из этих фактов ясно, что некоторые живые существа являются планетами.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a planet is secretly a robot. Every single thing that is secretly a robot is a living thing. From these facts, it is clear that a few living things are planets.

syllogism: పండ్లు అయిన కూరగాయలు ఏవీ లేవు. ఏ పండు కూడా బంగాళాదుంప కాదు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని బంగాళాదుంపలు కూరగాయలు కావు.
syllogism_orig: There are no vegetables that are fruit. It is the case that no fruit is a potato. Therefore, some potatoes are not vegetables.

syllogism: এটা সত্য নয় যে প্রাণীরা অ-পাখি। যে জিনিসগুলো হামিংবার্ড, তাদের মধ্যে কিছু অ-পাখি। এটা অবশ্যই সত্য যে প্রতিটি হামিংবার্ড প্রাণী নয়।
syllogism_orig: It is not the case that animals are non-birds. Of the items that are hummingbirds, some are non-birds. It must be the case that every single hummingbird is not an animal.

syllogism: তারাগুলি কোনোভাবেই জ্যোতিষ্ক নয়। যেকোনো কিছু যা একটি তারা তা একটি গ্রহ। এটি সত্য যে কিছু গ্রহ জ্যোতিষ্ক নয়।
syllogism_orig: Stars are in no way celestial bodies. Anything that is a star is a planet. It's the case that some planets are not celestial bodies.

syllogism: Kuna mamalia ambao ni paka. Kila mbwa ni mamalia. Kwa hivyo hakuna mbwa ambaye ni paka.
syllogism_orig: There exist mammals who are cats. Every single dog is a mammal. It follows that not a single dog is a cat.

syllogism: Einige Pinguine sind Vögel. Jeder Vogel ist ein Tier. Daraus folgt zwingend, dass einige Tiere Pinguine sind.
syllogism_orig: Some penguins are birds. Every bird is an animal. As such, it is necessarily true that some animals are penguins.

syllogism: Todo líquido é sólido. Não é verdade que alguma rocha seja um líquido. Nenhuma rocha é sólida.
syllogism_orig: Every single liquid is solid. It is not true that any rock is a liquid. It is the case that no rock is solid.

syllogism: Aucun corps céleste n'est une chose dans le ciel. Toutes les planètes sont des choses dans le ciel. L'implication est qu'un certain nombre de planètes ne sont pas des corps célestes.
syllogism_orig: There is no celestial body that is a thing in the sky. All planets are things in the sky. The implication is that a number of planets are not celestial bodies.

syllogism: పండ్లు ఏవీ కూరగాయలు కావు. ఆపిల్స్ ఏవీ పండ్లు కావు. ఈ ప్రకటనల నుండి, కొన్ని ఆపిల్స్ కూరగాయలు కావు అని నిర్ణయించవచ్చు.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no fruits are vegetables. It is also true that no apples are fruits. From these statements, one can conclude that some apples are not vegetables.

syllogism: Elk boek is een planeet. Elk boek is een meubelstuk. Dus er zijn meubelstukken die planeten zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every single book is a planet. Every single book is furniture. Therefore, there are pieces of furniture that are planets.

syllogism: Chaque chat est un animal. Tout ce qui est un chien est un animal. Il existe au moins un chien qui est un chat.
syllogism_orig: Every single cat is an animal. Everything that is a dog is an animal. There is at least one dog that is a cat.

syllogism: 每一个海洋都是一片水体。任何一片海都是海洋的一部分。这意味着所有的海都是水体。
syllogism_orig: Every single ocean is a body of water. Any area that is a sea is part of an ocean. This means that all seas are bodies of water.

syllogism: Kila mmea ni chakula. Kila kitu ambacho ni tunda ni chakula. Kwa hivyo, kila tunda ni mmea.
syllogism_orig: Every single plant is food. Everything that is a fruit is food. It follows that every fruit is a plant.

syllogism: Любое животное, которое является наземным животным, не является китом. Некоторые киты считаются животными, живущими в океане. Некоторые животные, живущие в океане, не являются наземными животными.
syllogism_orig: Any animal that is a land animal is not a whale. Some whales are considered animals that live in the ocean. It is the case that some animals living in the ocean are not land animals.

syllogism: Kila mboga si tunda. Sehemu ya vitu ambavyo ni kroasanti ni matunda. Matokeo ya hii ni kwamba baadhi ya kroasanti ni mboga.
syllogism_orig: Every single vegetable is not a fruit. A portion of the things that are croissants are fruits. The result of this is that some croissants are vegetables.

syllogism: Einige der Insekten sind Käfer. Jeder Käfer ist ein Gliederfüßer. Folglich sind einige Gliederfüßer Insekten.
syllogism_orig: A few of the insects are beetles. Every beetle is an arthropod. As a result, some arthropods are insects.

syllogism: Cada ser humano es una nube. También es cierto que todo mamífero es una nube. Esto demuestra que todos los mamíferos son humanos.
syllogism_orig: Every single human is a cloud. It is also true that every mammal is a cloud. This proves that all mammals are humans.

syllogism: Ningún perro es gato. Algunos perros son mascotas. Esto implica que algunas mascotas son gatos.
syllogism_orig: There are no dogs who are cats. A few dogs are pets. This implies that some pets are cats.

syllogism: Quelques chaises sont des personnes. Chaque personne est un être vivant. Par conséquent, quelques êtres vivants sont des chaises.
syllogism_orig: Some chairs are people. Every single person is a living being. Consequently, some living beings are chairs.

syllogism: Kila riwaya ni sayari. Hakuna sayari ambayo ni kitabu. Ni hitimisho la lazima kwamba hakuna kitabu ambacho ni riwaya.
syllogism_orig: Every single novel is a planet. No planet is a book. It is a necessary conclusion that no book is a novel.

syllogism: Es gibt nichts, das ein Planet ist, das nicht auch ein Himmelskörper ist. Es ist der Fall, dass jeder Himmelskörper ein Objekt im Weltraum ist. Daraus folgt, dass einige Objekte im Weltraum Planeten sind.
syllogism_orig: There is nothing that is a planet that is not also a celestial body. It is the case that every celestial body is an object in space. Therefore, some objects in space are planets.

syllogism: Todos os peixes são animais que vivem na água. Alguns tubarões não são peixes. Podemos inferir que alguns tubarões não são animais que vivem na água.
syllogism_orig: All fish are animals that live in water. Some sharks are not fish. We can infer that some sharks are not animals that live in water.

syllogism: প্রতিটি কুকুর কুকুর পরিবারের অন্তর্গত। যেকোনো কিছু যা একটি চিহুয়াহুয়া তা একটি কুকুর। এর মানে হলো প্রতিটি চিহুয়াহুয়া একটি কুকুর পরিবারের সদস্য।
syllogism_orig: Every single dog belongs to the canine family. Anything that is a chihuahua is a dog. This means that every chihuahua is a canine.

syllogism: Kila paka ni kiumbe hai. Kila mbwa ni kiumbe hai. Kwa hivyo, kuna mbwa ambao si paka.
syllogism_orig: Every single cat is a living creature. Every single dog is a living creature. As such, there are some dogs that are not cats.

syllogism: Chaque poisson est une créature qui est un amphibien. Sans exception, tous les requins sont des poissons. Par conséquent, il est certain que chaque requin est un amphibien.
syllogism_orig: Every fish is a creature that is an amphibian. Without exception, all sharks are fish. Therefore, it is certain that every shark is an amphibian.

syllogism: Ничто из того, что является автомобилем, не является мотоциклом. Некоторые вещи, называемые транспортными средствами, определены как автомобили. Это доказывает, что некоторые транспортные средства не являются мотоциклами.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a car is a motorcycle. A few things called vehicles are identified as being cars. This proves that some vehicles are not motorcycles.

syllogism: Aucun nombre n'est une table. Il n'est pas vrai que toute table soit un canapé. Il est le cas que certains canapés sont des nombres.
syllogism_orig: There are no numbers that are tables. It is not true that any table is a couch. It is the case that some couches are numbers.

syllogism: Alles, was ein Gemüse ist, ist keine Pflanze. Ein Teil der Dinge, die Gemüse sind, sind auch Karotten. Die Schlussfolgerung, dass einige Karotten keine Pflanzen sind, ist unausweichlich.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a vegetable is not a plant. A portion of the things that are vegetables are also carrots. The conclusion that some carrots are not plants is inescapable.

syllogism: Elke vogel is een vis. Sommige pinguïns, zoals bekend, zijn geen vissen. Dit impliceert noodzakelijkerwijs dat sommige pinguïns geen vogels zijn.
syllogism_orig: Every single bird is a fish. Some penguins, it is known, are not fish. This necessarily implies that some penguins are not birds.

syllogism: Nenhum objeto que é um carro é um barco. Um grupo de carros pode ser descrito como veículos. É uma consequência lógica que alguns veículos não são barcos.
syllogism_orig: Not a single object that is a car is a boat. A group of cars can be described as vehicles. It is a logical consequence that some vehicles are not boats.

syllogism: Eine Gruppe von Zahlen sind Planeten. Jeder Planet ist ein Himmelskörper. Folglich ist ein Teil der Himmelskörper Zahlen.
syllogism_orig: A group of numbers are planets. Every planet is a celestial body. As a result, a portion of celestial bodies are numbers.

syllogism: Existem alguns mamíferos que vivem em terra. É o caso que nenhum peixe vive em terra. Consequentemente, todos os peixes são mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: There are some mammals which live on land. It is the case that no fish lives on land. Consequently, all fish are mammals.

syllogism: Alcuni liquidi sono gatti. Ogni singola cosa che è un gatto è un mammifero. Quindi, alcuni mammiferi sono liquidi.
syllogism_orig: Some liquids are cats. Every single thing that is a cat is a mammal. Therefore, some mammals are liquids.

syllogism: ప్రతి కంప్యూటర్ ఒక మొక్క. మొక్కలు కాని కొన్ని ల్యాప్‌టాప్‌లు ఉన్నాయి. కొన్ని ల్యాప్‌టాప్‌లు కంప్యూటర్లు కావు అనేది తప్పనిసరి.
syllogism_orig: Every computer is a plant. There exist some laptops that are not plants. It must be the case that some laptops are not computers.

syllogism: Tutto ciò che è un cucchiaio è un pezzo di posateria. Nessuna giraffa può essere considerata un pezzo di posateria. Si può dire che alcune giraffe non sono cucchiai.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a spoon is a piece of cutlery. No giraffes can be considered pieces of cutlery. It can be said that some giraffes are not spoons.

syllogism: కొన్ని క్షీరదాలు వానరాలు. ప్రతి ఒక్క వానరం ఒక జంతువు. కాబట్టి, కొన్ని జంతువులు క్షీరదాలు.
syllogism_orig: There are some mammals that are primates. Every single primate is an animal. Consequently, some animals are mammals.

syllogism: Todo mamífero es un ser vivo. Ningún animal es un ser vivo. Ningún mamífero es un animal.
syllogism_orig: Every single mammal is a living thing. The set of animals contains no living things. Not a single mammal is an animal.

syllogism: Nenhum gato é peixe. Nenhum peixe é animal. Segue-se que alguns animais são gatos.
syllogism_orig: There are no cats which are fish. There are no fish which are animals. It follows that some animals are cats.

syllogism: Hakuna samaki ambao ni mamalia. Hakuna paka ambao wanachukuliwa kuwa samaki. Baadhi ya wanyama wa jamii ya paka si mamalia.
syllogism_orig: There are no fish that are mammals. No cats are considered fish. Some felines are not mammals.

syllogism: Множество честных людей и множество лжецов являются взаимоисключающими. Нет политиков, которые являются лжецами. Все политики — честные люди.
syllogism_orig: The set of honest people and the set of liars are mutually exclusive. There are no politicians who are liars. All politicians are honest people.

syllogism: কোনো প্রাণী নেই যা উড়ন্ত যান এবং একই সাথে কুকুরজাতীয়। সমস্ত উড়ন্ত যান হলো কুকুর। এটি অনিবার্যভাবে সত্য যে কুকুরদের একটি অংশ কুকুরজাতীয় নয়।
syllogism_orig: There are no animals that are flying vehicles and are also canines. All flying vehicles are dogs. It is necessarily true that a portion of dogs is not canines.

syllogism: Aucun carré n'est rond. Aucun cercle n'est un carré. Il s'ensuit donc que quelques cercles sont carrés.
syllogism_orig: There are no squares which are round. There are no circles which are squares. It follows, then, that some circles are square.

syllogism: Ogni cosa che è un mammifero è un animale. Alcuni leoni sono mammiferi. Pertanto, tutti i leoni possono essere considerati animali.
syllogism_orig: Every item that is a mammal is an animal. Some lions are mammals. Therefore, all lions can be said to be animals.

syllogism: Il est vrai qu'aucun nombre n'est une onde. Aucun son n'est un nombre. Il s'ensuit qu'aucun son n'est une onde.
syllogism_orig: It is true that no numbers are waves. No sounds are numbers. It follows that no sounds are waves.

syllogism: Aucune voiture ne peut être appelée un bateau. Il est également vrai que chaque voiture est un type de véhicule. Cela a conduit à la conclusion qu'une partie des véhicules sont des voitures.
syllogism_orig: There are no cars that can be called boats. It is also true that every car is a type of vehicle. This has led to the conclusion that a portion of vehicles are cars.

syllogism: Каждая кошка является животным. Существуют некоторые рыбы, которые являются кошками. Рыбы никоим образом не являются животными.
syllogism_orig: Every single cat is an animal. There are some fish which are cats. Fish are in no way animals.

syllogism: Es ist wahr, dass alles, was ein Vogel ist, ein geflügeltes Wesen ist. Es gibt keine Insekten, die Vögel sind. Eine Schlussfolgerung, die daraus gezogen werden kann, ist, dass es Insekten gibt, die geflügelte Wesen sind.
syllogism_orig: It is true that everything which is a bird is a winged creature. There are no insects which are birds. A conclusion that can be drawn from this is that there are insects which are winged creatures.

syllogism: Tout ce qui est une pomme est un nuage. Chaque pomme est un fruit. Il s'ensuit que tous les fruits sont des nuages.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is an apple is a cloud. Every single apple is a fruit. It follows from this that all fruits are clouds.

syllogism: Nada que é um animal de estimação é também um felino. Alguns gatos são animais de estimação. Isso leva à conclusão de que um certo número de gatos não são felinos.
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a pet animal is also a feline. Some cats happen to be pet animals. This leads to the conclusion that a certain number of cats are not felines.

syllogism: Все люди, которые являются врачами, имеют медицинское образование. Ни один человек с медицинским образованием не является учителем. Это означает, что ни один учитель не является врачом.
syllogism_orig: All people who are doctors are those who have medical training. There are no people with medical training who are teachers. This means that no one who is a teacher is a doctor.

syllogism: పక్షులైన క్షీరదాలు ఏవీ లేవు. క్షీరదమైన ప్రతి ఒక్కటి జంతువు. కొన్ని జంతువులు పక్షులు కాకపోవడం నిజం.
syllogism_orig: There are no mammals that are birds. Every single thing that is a mammal is an animal. It is the case that some animals fail to be birds.

syllogism: Alcuni dei felini nel mondo sono leoni. Ogni singolo felino è un mammifero. Di conseguenza, alcuni mammiferi risultano essere leoni.
syllogism_orig: Some of the felines in the world are lions. Every single feline is a mammal. Consequently, some mammals are found to be lions.

syllogism: Absoluut geen primaire kleur is ook een secundaire kleur. Sommige dingen die zichtbare kleuren zijn, worden geclassificeerd als primaire kleuren. Hieruit volgt dat niet elke zichtbare kleur een secundaire kleur is.
syllogism_orig: Absolutely no primary color is also a secondary color. Some things which are visible colors are classified as primary colors. It is thus the case that not every visible color is a secondary color.

syllogism: Il existe des nuages qui ne sont pas faits d'eau. Chaque nuage est fait de vapeur. Il s'ensuit qu'il existe des choses faites de vapeur qui ne sont pas faites d'eau.
syllogism_orig: There are some things which are clouds that are not made of water. Every single cloud is made of vapour. It follows from this that there exist some things made of vapour that are not made of water.

syllogism: La categoría de peces es un subconjunto de la categoría de animales. Todos los animales que son perros también son animales. Nada que sea un perro es un pez.
syllogism_orig: The category of fish is a subset of the category of animals. All animals that are dogs are also animals. Nothing that is a dog is a fish.

syllogism: Нечто, являющееся живым организмом, является млекопитающим. Всё множество людей состоит из живых организмов. Все люди являются млекопитающими.
syllogism_orig: Something that is a living organism is a mammal. The entire set of people is composed of living organisms. It is the case that all people are mammals.

syllogism: Jedes einzelne Laptop ist ein Computer. Es gibt einige Abakusse, die keine Computer sind. Daraus folgt, dass einige Abakusse keine Laptops sind.
syllogism_orig: Every single laptop is a computer. There are some abacuses which are not computers. This leads to the conclusion that some abacuses are not laptops.

syllogism: 狗之中，有一些是食肉动物。所有的狗都属于哺乳动物。因此，哺乳动物之中，有一些是食肉动物。
syllogism_orig: Among dogs, there are some that are carnivores. All dogs belong to the class of mammals. Consequently, among the class of mammals, some are carnivores.

syllogism: Ogni singolo felino è un mammifero. Qualsiasi cosa che sia un gatto è un felino. Almeno un gatto è un mammifero.
syllogism_orig: Every single feline is a mammal. Anything that is a cat is a feline. At least one cat is a mammal.

syllogism: Non c'è alcuna sovrapposizione tra la categoria delle verdure e la categoria della frutta. Qualsiasi cosa sia una mela è, per definizione, un frutto. Le mele e le verdure sono due categorie separate.
syllogism_orig: There is no overlap between the category of vegetables and the category of fruits. Anything that is an apple is, by definition, a fruit. Apples and vegetables are two separate categories.

syllogism: 每一个狗都是动物。有些猫不是狗。我们可以推断出有些猫不是动物。
syllogism_orig: Every single thing which is a dog is an animal. Some cats are not dogs. We can infer that some cats are not animals.

syllogism: Tudo o que é uma árvore é feito de madeira. Toda cadeira é feita de madeira. Conclui-se necessariamente que toda cadeira é uma árvore.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a tree is made of wood. Every single chair is made of wood. It is necessarily concluded that every chair is a tree.

syllogism: Er zijn geen honden die katten zijn. Het is het geval dat geen kat een vis is. Daarom is het mogelijk te concluderen dat sommige vissen geen honden zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no dogs that are cats. It is the case that no cat is a fish. Therefore, it is possible to conclude that some fish are not dogs.

syllogism: Non esistono uccelli che possano essere chiamati pesci. È anche vero che ogni uccello è un tipo di animale. Ciò ha portato alla conclusione che una parte degli animali sono uccelli.
syllogism_orig: There are no birds that can be called fish. It is also true that every bird is a type of animal. This has led to the conclusion that a portion of animals are birds.

syllogism: Tutto ciò che è un essere umano è anche un primate. Tutto ciò che è un essere umano è anche un animale bipede. Di conseguenza, alcuni animali bipedi sono primati.
syllogism_orig: Everything that is a human is also a primate. Everything that is a human is also a bipedal animal. Consequently, some bipedal animals are primates.

syllogism: Keine Fußbekleidung ist Kleidung. Jeder Schuh ist eine Art von Fußbekleidung. Daraus folgt, dass kein Schuh Kleidung ist.
syllogism_orig: There are no footwear items that are clothing. Every shoe is a type of footwear. It can be concluded that no shoe is clothing.

syllogism: సాలీడులు అరాక్నిడ్‌లు కాలేవు. అన్ని టరాంటులాలు సాలీడులు అనేది వాస్తవం. కొన్ని టరాంటులాలు అరాక్నిడ్‌లు కావు అని నిర్ణయించబడాలి.
syllogism_orig: Spiders cannot be arachnids. It is a fact that all tarantulas are spiders. It must be concluded that some tarantulas are not arachnids.

syllogism: Non ci sono gatti che siano anche cani. È noto che non ci sono cani che siano uccelli. Si potrebbe concludere che nessun uccello è un gatto.
syllogism_orig: There are no cats that are also dogs. It is known that there are no dogs that are birds. One might conclude that no birds are cats.

syllogism: Любой объект, который является фигурой, является животным. Не существует кругов, которые также являются животными. Часть фигур не является кругами.
syllogism_orig: Any object that is a shape is an animal. There are no circles that are also animals. A portion of shapes are not circles.

syllogism: Existem algumas coisas que são água que não são líquidos. Toda água pode ser derramada. Segue-se que algumas coisas que podem ser derramadas não são líquidos.
syllogism_orig: There exist some things which are water which are not liquids. All water can be poured. It follows that some things that can be poured are not liquids.

syllogism: Geen enkel vierkant is een cirkel. Alle vierkanten zijn in feite vormen. Het is het geval dat sommige vormen geen cirkels zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no squares which are circles. All squares are, in fact, shapes. It's the case that some shapes are not circles.

syllogism: Ningún automóvil puede ser clasificado como una bicicleta. Todo coche es un automóvil. Esto significa que ningún coche puede ser una bicicleta.
syllogism_orig: There is no automobile that can be classified as a bicycle. Every single car is an automobile. This means that no car can be a bicycle.

syllogism: Het is niet het geval dat elke persoon bloed heeft. Elke persoon is een zoogdier. Men kan daaruit concluderen dat sommige zoogdieren geen bloed hebben.
syllogism_orig: It is not the case that every single person has blood. Every person is a mammal. One can therefore conclude that some mammals do not have blood.

syllogism: Nenhum inseto é um animal. Todo formiga é um inseto. Consequentemente, nenhuma formiga é um animal.
syllogism_orig: There are no insects that are animals. Every single ant is an insect. Consequently, nothing that is an ant is an animal.

syllogism: ఏదైనా ఉపాధ్యాయుడు అయినది విద్యాబోధకుడు. విద్యార్థి అయిన ప్రతి ఒక్కరు విద్యాబోధకుడు కూడా. కొందరు విద్యార్థులు ఉపాధ్యాయులు కారు అని తార్కికంగా తేలుతుంది.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a teacher is an educator. Every single person who is a student is also an educator. It logically follows that there are some students who are not teachers.

syllogism: Kuna viumbe fulani ambavyo ni mamalia, lakini si reptilia. Kila kiumbe ambacho ni mamalia pia huhesabiwa kuwa mnyama. Kutokana na kauli hizi, inafuata kwamba baadhi ya wanyama si reptilia.
syllogism_orig: There exist certain creatures that are mammals, yet they are not reptiles. Every creature that is a mammal is also considered an animal. From these statements, it follows that some animals are not reptiles.

syllogism: Существуют некоторые рыбы, которые являются млекопитающими. Некоторые слоны являются млекопитающими. Следовательно, некоторые слоны являются рыбами.
syllogism_orig: There exist some fish that are mammals. A few elephants are mammals. Consequently, some elephants are fish.

syllogism: ప్రతి ఒక్క కుక్క ఒక జంతువు. జంతువు అయిన ప్రతిదీ ఒక క్షీరదం. కాబట్టి ప్రతి క్షీరదం ఒక జంతువు అనేది తప్పనిసరిగా నిజం అయి ఉండాలి.
syllogism_orig: Every single dog is an animal. Everything that is an animal is a mammal. It must therefore be true that every mammal is an animal.

syllogism: Kundi la vitu visivyo hai na kundi la kompyuta havina wanachama wa pamoja. Angalau binadamu mmoja ni kompyuta. Angalau binadamu mmoja ni kitu kisicho hai.
syllogism_orig: The category of non-living things and the category of computers have no members in common. At least one human is a computer. At least one human is a non-living thing.

syllogism: Nenhum item de duas rodas é um veículo. Um certo número de bicicletas encontra-se entre os itens de duas rodas. Portanto, um certo número de bicicletas não pertence à categoria de veículos.
syllogism_orig: It is the case that no two-wheeled item is a vehicle. A certain number of bicycles can be found among two-wheeled items. Therefore, a number of bicycles do not belong to the category of vehicles.

syllogism: Kein motorisiertes Fahrzeug ist ein Fahrrad. Es ist auch wahr, dass kein motorisiertes Fahrzeug ein Auto ist. Daraus folgt, dass kein Auto ein Fahrrad ist.
syllogism_orig: Not a single motorized vehicle is a bicycle. It is also true that no motorized vehicle is a car. It follows that no car is a bicycle.

syllogism: Cada mamífero es un insecto. No hay insectos que sean perros. Basándose en esto, debe ser el caso de que algunos perros no son mamíferos.
syllogism_orig: Every single mammal is an insect. There are no insects which are dogs. Based on this, it must be the case that some dogs are not mammals.

syllogism: Geen enkel fruit is een ding dat aan bomen groeit. Elke appel is een ding dat aan bomen groeit. Bijgevolg kan worden gezegd dat sommige appels geen fruit zijn.
syllogism_orig: There are no fruits that are things that grow on trees. Every single apple is a thing that grows on a tree. Consequently, it can be said that some apples are not fruits.

syllogism: Il est vrai que tout reptile a de la fourrure. Certains serpents sont connus pour être des reptiles. Par conséquent, nous pouvons conclure que certains serpents ont de la fourrure.
syllogism_orig: It is true that every reptile has fur. Some snakes are known to be reptiles. Therefore, we can conclude that some snakes have fur.

syllogism: প্রতিটি ব্যক্তি যিনি একজন অধ্যাপক তিনি একজন শিক্ষাবিদ। যেকোনো শিক্ষাবিদ একজন জ্ঞানী ব্যক্তি। অতএব, কিছু জ্ঞানী ব্যক্তি অধ্যাপক।
syllogism_orig: Every single person who is a professor is an academic. Any academic is a knowledgeable person. Therefore, some knowledgeable people are professors.

syllogism: Elk levend wezen is een wolk. Het is waar dat elke vogel een wolk is. Hieruit volgt dat geen enkele vogel een levend wezen is.
syllogism_orig: Every single living being is a cloud. It is true that every bird is a cloud. It follows that no bird is a living being.

syllogism: Es gibt alle Männer, die Menschen sind. Jeder einzelne Mann ist ein Sterblicher. Folglich sind alle Sterblichen Menschen.
syllogism_orig: There are all men that are humans. Every single man is a mortal. As a result, all mortals are humans.

syllogism: Existen algunas cosas que son árboles que no son pinos. Todo lo que es un árbol es una planta. Se sigue lógicamente que hay algunas plantas que no son pinos.
syllogism_orig: There exist some things which are trees that are not pines. Everything that is a tree is a plant. It logically follows that there are some plants that are not pines.

syllogism: যা উদ্ভিদ তার কোনোটিই স্তন্যপায়ী নয়। বৃক্ষের একটি অংশ উদ্ভিদের মধ্যে পাওয়া যায়। সুতরাং, এমন কোনো বৃক্ষ নেই যা স্তন্যপায়ীও বটে।
syllogism_orig: Nothing that is a plant is a mammal. A portion of trees are to be found among the plants. Thus, there are no trees that are also mammals.

syllogism: Всё, что является квадратом, является также четырёхугольником. Треугольник никогда не может быть четырёхугольником. Ни один треугольник не является квадратом.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a square is also a quadrilateral. A triangle can never be a quadrilateral. It is the case that no triangle is a square.

syllogism: Toda e qualquer coisa que é um cão é um mamífero. Todo mamífero é um animal. Disto, segue-se que alguns animais são de fato cães.
syllogism_orig: Every single thing that is a dog is a mammal. Every mammal is an animal. From this, it follows that some animals are indeed dogs.

syllogism: Tudo que é um carro não é um avião. Não há veículos que sejam carros. Consequentemente, todo veículo é um avião.
syllogism_orig: Anything that is a car is not an airplane. There are no vehicles that are cars. Consequently, every vehicle is an airplane.

syllogism: Некоторые рыбы являются лососями, которые живут в пресной воде. Все лососи являются рыбами. Следовательно, некоторые рыбы являются пресноводными рыбами.
syllogism_orig: There are some fish that are salmon that live in fresh water. All salmon are fish. Therefore, some fish are fresh water fish.

syllogism: যে কেউ শিক্ষক সে একজন শিক্ষাবিদ। কোনো কিছু যা প্রধান শিক্ষক তা শিক্ষক নয়। সুতরাং, কিছু প্রধান শিক্ষক শিক্ষাবিদ।
syllogism_orig: Anyone who is a teacher is an educator. Nothing that is a principal is a teacher. Consequently, some principal is an educator.

syllogism: Hakuna viti ambavyo vinaweza kuchukuliwa kuwa vyombo vya muziki. Viti fulani vipo ambavyo pia ni vitu vya kale. Hitimisho kwamba sehemu ya vitu vya kale si vyombo vya muziki halieepuki.
syllogism_orig: There are no chairs that can be considered musical instruments. Certain chairs exist that are also antiques. The conclusion that a portion of antiques are not musical instruments is inescapable.
